Job Description Summary Do you want to drive the commercial strategy for an industry-leading portfolio that powers the world's energy infrastructure? GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Bushings Sales Manager to join our Power Transmission team based in Sesto San Giovanni, Italy. Job Description GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. "GE" carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. "Ver" signals Earth's lush ecosystems, while "Nova" nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver. Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life. Electrification Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks. Let's Talk About The Role The Bushings Sales Manager will lead the commercial growth of our bushing portfolio for transformers, generators, and substation applications across the European market. You will act as the primary commercial lead, building deep relationships with key stakeholders and collaborating with local sales teams to drive new business. By defining market-entry strategies and leading the end-to-end sales process—from initial specification through to contract closure—you will play a vital role in delivering exceptional value to our customers and expanding our market presence. How You Will Make a Difference Driving growth by deploying strategic market-entry plans and meeting order intake and gross margin targets. Leading the "spec-in" and "spec-out" process to influence customer specifications and secure product qualification across the region. Collaborating with Account Managers and local sales teams and partner with the tendering team to develop competitive, value-added technical and commercial offers. Directing tender approval process including internal presentation of the deal to the management to get the relevant validations. Close contracts and transfer to the factory execution teams. Managing the internal risk assessment process for commercial, financial, and legal viability to ensure successful project delivery. Creating and negotiating high-impact contracts while resolving technical and commercial clarifications to ensure seamless hand-off to execution teams. Special Role Requirements Able to travel frequently throughout the European region to meet with customers and support project assignments. Skills For Success You should be a strategic and dynamic sales professional with: The ability to present complex technical solutions to diverse stakeholders with clarity and impact. The capability to plan, document, and execute large-scale commercial programs in a global environment. An understanding of the electrical transmission business, including bushings, generator, transformer, or substation equipment. An expertise in navigating tender complexities and resolving contract concerns. A keen interest in fostering cross-functional collaboration within a fast-paced environment. Professional proficiency in English (any other languages such as French, German, or Spanish would be a plus). A formal education and subsequent University degree in Engineering (Electrical or Management preferred) or a related field are nice to have but we are also interested in your total experience and professional achievements in a commercial or sales environment . Where And How You'll Work This is a permanent position based in our Sesto San Giovanni office. We have a hybrid working model which gives you flexibility to work from our offices and from home. Our Culture Every action shapes our future. That's why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve. Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy. Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world's electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change! We're determined to be the best place to grow We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We're committed to providing you with the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey. We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do. Inclusion & Diversity We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone. As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike. Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging. Founding Marketing Lead Founding Marketing Lead presso Flottando — Milano | LinkedIn Lavoro Vai al contenuto principale LinkedIn Founding Marketing Lead in zona Boydton, VA Espandi ricerca Questo pulsante mostra il tipo di ricerca attualmente selezionato. Lavoro Persone Learning Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Accedi Iscriviti ora Founding Marketing Lead Flottando Milano Candidati Founding Marketing Lead Flottando Milano 2 giorni fa 138 candidati Guarda chi è stato assunto da Flottando per questo ruolo Candidati Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About this Job Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office, 2 remote) Type: Full-time – with a clear path to Head of Marketing About Flottando Company cars are boring. We need someone crazy enough to make them exciting. 🚗 At Flottando we build AI software for corporate fleets. That means invoices, multe, fringe benefits, contract renewals and the Excel files that HR, Procurement and Finance trade back and forth every month. Hundreds of Italian companies already use us, and many of them are happy to tell their story. Now we need someone to go out and tell it, loudly. The role Let's be honest about this role. There's no marketing team waiting for you, no agency, no big budget and no brand guidelines. There's you, a laptop, a small and hungry founding team, and a product customers love. You'll write the post, film the video, book the guest, run the webinar, set up the event booth, send the follow-ups, and check on Monday whether any of it turned into pipeline. Then you'll do it again, better. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the best job ever, keep reading. Where this goes 🚀 You start as our first marketer. As Flottando grows in Italy and expands into Europe, you grow with it: you'll hire the team, own the budget and become our Head of Marketing. We're not hiring someone to fill a seat. We're looking for the person who will lead marketing here. What you will do • Call happy customers and turn them into case studies, videos and LinkedIn posts, starting in week one • Run our social channels yourself: writing, filming, editing, posting • Organize webinars and events from scratch, including topic, speakers, promotion, hosting and follow-up • Generate leads, hand them to sales, and track what becomes revenue • Launch our new AI products and make people understand why they matter • Do our employer branding so great people want to join us • Test, measure, kill what doesn't work and double down on what does • Challenge the founders. The CEO sets the strategy, and you push back when the data says otherwise Here's an example. In a demo, a fleet manager says she used to spend three days a month building cost reports in Excel. You hear it. You call her, record a 60-second video, turn it into a LinkedIn post, build a webinar around it, and check two weeks later how many demos it brought in. That's the mindset we're looking for. Who we are looking for You're probably a great fit if: • You're hands-on: you've done the work yourself, not just managed others doing it • You love startups: chaos, speed and building from zero excite you • You're entrepreneurial: you don't wait for a brief, a budget or permission. You ship • You're analytical: you care about leads and revenue, not likes • You're a strong communicator in writing, on camera and on stage • You're creative enough to make fleet management fun (yes, really) • You're high-energy and positive. Ogni giorno lavori sul campo: analizzi il mercato, costruisci relazioni solide, intercetti opportunità e proponi soluzioni HR a valore aggiunto, promuovendo in modo proattivo tutti i servizi del Gruppo. Allo stesso tempo, fai crescere le persone: ispiri il team, definisci obiettivi chiari e condivisi e crei un ambiente orientato alla performance, alla collaborazione e al risultato. Ti muovi in un contesto dinamico e competitivo, supportato da strumenti digitali e in costante connessione con le funzioni aziendali, con un obiettivo chiaro: generare impatto, far crescere il business e accompagnare il successo della tua filiale e dei tuoi clienti. Livello retribuzione di base 35.000,00 €/yr - 45.000,00 €/anno Importante realtà operante nel settore dei servizi e della mobilità è alla ricerca di un/a IT Project Manager - con competenze multicanale Web & Mobile da inserire all'interno dell'Area ICT & Digital. La risorsa si occuperà della gestione e dell'evoluzione dei canali aziendali (siti web e app), supportando l'implementazione di nuovi servizi e il miglioramento della customer experience. Responsabilità La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione e dell'evoluzione dell'ecosistema aziendale, con particolare focus su piattaforme web, applicazioni mobile e servizi digitali rivolti agli utenti. In particolare si occuperà di: Gestione, monitoraggio e ottimizzazione delle piattaforme web e mobile aziendali, garantendone affidabilità, performance e continuità operativa. Raccolta e analisi dei requisiti di business, definizione delle specifiche funzionali e coordinamento degli sviluppi applicativi. Governance del ciclo di vita delle applicazioni digitali, pianificando roadmap evolutive e nuove implementazioni. Collaborazione con team IT, fornitori e stakeholder aziendali per la realizzazione di soluzioni digitali innovative. Implementazione e ottimizzazione di servizi digitali e funzionalità a supporto dell'esperienza utente. Supporto all'evoluzione dei canali digitali e delle piattaforme e-commerce, contribuendo al miglioramento della customer journey. Gestione e sviluppo di strumenti di automazione, customer engagement e digital interaction. Presidio delle tematiche di accessibilità, usabilità, sicurezza applicativa e conformità normativa. Supervisione dell'integrazione tra piattaforme, CRM, database e altri sistemi aziendali. Analisi dei dati e monitoraggio delle performance digitali attraverso KPI e dashboard dedicate. Supporto alle attività di reporting e data-driven decision making per l'ottimizzazione dei servizi digitali. Profilo Verranno prese in considerazione figure in possesso dei seguenti requisiti Laurea in discipline STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) o percorso equivalente. Esperienza maturata in aziende operanti nei settori Trasporti, Logistica, Mobilità o Infrastrutture Esperienza nella gestione di applicazioni web e mobile in contesti strutturati. Conoscenza delle architetture digitali, dei processi e-commerce e delle principali piattaforme di Ticketing e vendita online. Conoscenza delle dinamiche legate alla mobilità. Esperienza nell'utilizzo e gestione di piattaforme CRM, database e strumenti di marketing automation. Ottima conoscenza del linguaggio SQL e dei principali strumenti di interrogazione e analisi dati. Familiarità con tematiche di integrazione applicativa, gestione dati e servizi digitali. Conoscenza delle normative GDPR, delle linee guida di accessibilità digitale e dei requisiti di compliance IT. Ottime capacità di analisi, project management e coordinamento di stakeholder interni ed esterni. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Customer Care Operations Lead is the essential link between the Global Customer Care Centre of Excellence (CoE) and your local market, you’ll own and manage instrument order fulfilment, customer enquiries, resolve escalated requests , and ensure every interaction meets both global standards and specific local needs and requirements. You will partner across commercial, service, supply chain, and customer care functions to drive customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while balancing global processes with local market needs and contribute to team training, making a meaningful impact on our customers, partners, and business every day. This is an onsite role in Buccinasco, Italy. In This Role You Will Have The Opportunity To Oversee complex instrument installations, relocations, deinstallations, backlog execution, , supplier coordination, forecasting, invoicing and regional supply chain requirements to ensure seamless customer delivery. Serve as the regional contact for customer enquiries, escalation support leveraging Voice of Customer insights, operational data, and trend analysis to resolve issues, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver successful outcomes. Partner with Sales, Service, Contracts, Tenders, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and other stakeholders to remove barriers, improve operational performance, and enhance the end-to-end customer experience. Monitor performance metrics, identify trends, implement process improvements, and balance global standards with local business requirements to improve efficiency, service delivery, and business results. Act as the Customer Care Center of Excellence (CoE) market representative, translating regional needs into global improvements while supporting business continuity, training, knowledge sharing, and process standardization across teams. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor's degree or equivalent extensive experience in customer-facing roles with a strong understanding of Customer Care processes, customer escalation management, quality practices, and continuous improvement methodologies to ensure consistent service delivery. Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex situations, apply sound judgment, and drive customer issues and escalations to timely resolution through a structured, solution-oriented approach. Proven experience coordinating across multiple functions, building strong relationships, and working effectively within a matrix organization to deliver business results and exceptional customer experiences. Ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, think critically under pressure, and adapt quickly to changing business needs while maintaining a positive and professional attitude. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. The Opportunity We're expanding our product ownership capability to accelerate Talent transformation and support our journey to becoming a skills-based organisation. As our Global Skills & Talent Intelligence Product Owner, you'll shape how employees discover opportunities, build skills, and develop their careers. Working at the intersection of Talent, technology, data, and AI, you'll define product strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver solutions that create exceptional employee experiences and measurable business value. Your Key Responsibilities Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for Skills and Talent Intelligence products. Partner with Talent and Technology leaders to align priorities, investments, and outcomes. Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities that enhance workforce insights and employee experiences. Translate business and user needs into scalable, data-driven solutions. Use data, feedback, and market insights to continuously improve product performance and value. Lead prioritisation, governance, and investment decisions across a global stakeholder community. Deliver outcomes through collaboration, influence, and strong cross-functional partnerships. Support successful deployment, adoption, and value realisation of Talent technology solutions. Skills And Attributes For Success Proven product ownership experience, balancing strategic vision with execution. Strong understanding of Talent technology and the role of skills data in workforce transformation. Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills. Ability to leverage AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve Talent outcomes. Strong problem-solving skills, commercial awareness, and user-focused decision-making. Ability to navigate complexity, build alignment, and deliver results through peers in a global environment. Ideally, You'll Also Bring expertise in platforms that enable skills-based organisations. Have hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors, particularly Talent Intelligence Hub (TIH) and Career & Talent Development (CTD). Possess knowledge of ProFinda or similar talent marketplace and skills intelligence platforms. What we offer you At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Speichern Diesen Job melden Introduction Are you passionate about building and operating Kubernetes platforms at scale? Do you enjoy diving deep into complex technical challenges, from low-level troubleshooting to platform architecture? And are you someone who enjoys taking ownership, driving technical excellence and helping other engineers grow? If so, we are looking for you! As a hands-on Kubernetes Platform Engineer with technical leadership responsibilities, you will own the design, operation and continuous improvement of our enterprise Kubernetes platform, which supports mission-critical financial services in a PCI DSS-regulated environment. This role combines deep technical expertise with technical leadership. Whether you are tracing a production incident down to the kernel, shaping the platform architecture or mentoring fellow engineers, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact. Working closely with development, security and infrastructure teams, you will help ensure that our platform is reliable, secure and a great foundation for building software. The position is available immediately or by mutual agreement. Responsibilities Design, operate and evolve Rancher-managed RKE2 clusters: provisioning, upgrades, capacity planning, troubleshooting and lifecycle management. Automate infrastructure and application delivery with Terraform, Helm, Argo CD and GitOps practices. Engineer core platform services: networking, ingress, storage, secrets management, observability and disaster recovery. Build and improve observability with Dynatrace, Splunk, but also Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, Loki, Tempo and OpenTelemetry. Lead the response to complex production incidents across Kubernetes, Linux and storage, with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term fixes rather than workarounds. Provide technical leadership, architectural guidance and mentoring to colleagues. Qualifications Several years of hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, ideally RKE2 and Rancher or a comparable enterprise distribution. Knowledge of SRE principles and strong GitOps and infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, Helm, Argo CD). Solid Linux, networking and storage troubleshooting skills. Practical experience with Kubernetes security and modern observability. Experience working in a regulated environment, or the willingness and discipline to work in one. Fluent English. German and Italian is a plus. Job Benefits At Viseca you will work in a dynamic and creative environment with good development opportunities. We maintain an open and uncomplicated culture and offer our employees extensive decision-making powers in addition to a thorough introduction, home office possibility, attractive employment conditions and progressive fringe benefits. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Ciao, we're TextYess 👋 We're the AI-first CRM that turns conversations into revenue. On-site, WhatsApp, email, voice: our AI Agents sell, support, and retain customers for the best B2C brands out there, autonomously. We believe the future of commerce is warmer, more human than ever - just at a scale no human team could pull off alone. We've raised €7M+ and work with brands like Ducati, Pittarosso, MC2 Saint Barth, and Doppelgänger. We're a lean, fast, Italian-born scale-up now expanding our story internationally and this role is a big part of writing it. The role We're growing from a WhatsApp marketing point solution into a full CRM, and our product already wins deals against Klaviyo, Omnisend and other big players in the space. Yet, we haven’t decided how we position it, how we stand apart or how we win. We also ship improvements every week but most of the market, including many of our own customers, never hears about them. As our first Product Marketing Manager, you'll own how TextYess is positioned, priced and launched, and give sales and customers the proof that wins and expands deals, reporting to our Head of Marketing and working closely with the founders, product and sales. What You'll Actually Be Doing Own our positioning and differentiation for the full CRM: who we're for, why we win against competitors, and what we say about it on the site, in ads, in sales decks and on every call. Run launches (big or small) for every relevant release, aimed at prospects, existing customers and sales: You decide what’s worth a launch, the story and who hears it, and how to turn it into content such as ads, posts and webinars. Build pricing and packaging for the full CRM with the founders and product, along with the pricing story sales tells. Create what sales needs to win: the deck, battlecards against Klaviyo and others, objection handling, comparison pages and a library of customer case studies. Grow the CRM within our customer base: most customers came to us for WhatsApp. Get them using email and the rest of the CRM, and turn the happiest ones into case studies, reviews and referrals. Know why brands choose us, or don’t: talk to customers, listen to won and lost deals and to brands that switched from Klaviyo, and track competitors, so our positioning is built on evidence. What You Bring A proven top performer. You stood out at a high-growth startup, or trained at MBB consulting or in investment banking, and have since done at least 2 years of B2B SaaS product marketing. Martech, CRM or ecommerce software experience is a plus. You've positioned a product against bigger players and launched to existing customers, not only prospects, and can show what changed: win rate, adoption or pipeline. Structured thinking and fast execution: you turn a messy market into a clear story, then ship it in weeks, not quarters. You start from customers: you run interviews, sit in sales calls, and build the story from what buyers tell you. Fluent Italian and English, and you write simply in both. Why TextYess Be our first PMM. You're a key marketing hire, so you'll help build the marketing function, not just join it. Own the biggest launch in our history. The full CRM goes to market in 2027, and you decide how it's positioned, priced and launched. A winning story nobody has told yet. Our product already wins deals against Klaviyo. Your job is to make the market hear it. Work directly with the founders, product and sales. No layers between your work and the decisions it shapes. Grow as fast as you push. Your scope grows with what you prove you can do, and as we scale this role can grow into leading marketing. What we offer: Salary: The gross annual salary (RAL) ranges from €45000 to €65000 depending on relevant experience and fit with the role. Stock Options: You'll receive a highly incentivizing stock options package so that if TextYess becomes a giant company, you can enjoy substantial rewards. We want to make TextYess feel like yours too. Infinite growth and responsibility: We are still at the beginning of our journey, and the challenges we will face in the coming years are numerous and highly demanding. Your work will be crucial to the success or failure of TextYess! Our hiring process We keep it real and reasonably fast: Screening call, let's just talk. Communication, fit, the basics. Technical Interview with the Hiring Manager for this role Interview + live case study, a conversation about the positioning and launches you've owned, followed by a short case study (2 hours max) built from real customer calls and release notes. Founder & Team conversations, here you meet the people you'd actually work with. Debrief, reference check, and decision. We move quickly once we're there. Sound like you? If you want to own something real from day one and help write TextYess’ growth story, we want to meet you! TextYess is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Summary The Molecular Imaging (MI) Modality Manager is accountable to grow orders, revenue and margins for GEHC MI products lines within the IMI geographical area (Italy, Israel and Malta). He/She drives a coherent product differentiation for the assigned product range and optimizes the use of resources in conjunction with Zone Manager and Enterprise Sales team to cover market potential for his/her segment, to achieve the Operating plan. The Modality Manager has direct management of the Product Sales Specialists (PSS) Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Financial Performance & Sales Management Is accountable to achieve the quarterly and yearly Operating Plan targets (Orders, Sales, Contribution Margin, and Cash, where applicable) for Italy, Israel and Malta. Is accountable for timely and accurate forecasting of Orders and S&I and is responsible for driving optimal Imaging Operating Mechanisms (IOMs) to monitor and track progress of opportunities and deliver on Order commitment. Is responsible to ensure that all PSS utilize the required sales tool (CRM) to create pipeline visibility and assist accurate forecasting (SFDC rigor). Provide input to and contribute to the formulation of the yearly business planning cycles for the MI Business within IMI (e.g. Marketing plan, BPR session). Is responsible to set appropriate OP targets for PSS Customers, Market & Product expertise Continuously develop deep clinical and technical knowledge of products, including awareness of current and future trends in MI healthcare technology and healthcare funding mechanisms. Understand and analyze market dynamics and competition to set business strategies and develop opportunities (i.e., protect IB); provide ongoing feedback to management (Region and marketing). Drive product’s configuration quality at the point of offer and order entry to ensure accuracy, configuration integrity and that all requirements are tied to documented customer inputs. Lead, educate and drive products positioning & strategy (value proposition and key messages) of MI product/solution/service through adeguate products training sessions to sales teams (PSS & AM). Coach and assist the PSS/PCS with the differentiation of product offerings during the various stages of the sales process; ensure that all PSS/PCS have clear opportunity management activity and call plans to ensure efficient coverage of decision makers and influencers Maintain professional relations with KOLs and customers in Academia, and nurture relationships with professional society stakeholders, to ensure understanding of needs and positioning new products (NPIs) in these key customer groups. Team Coaching Drive a culture of Simplification, Fastwork and Digital adoption among the team members, encouraging and facilitating the collaboration across horizontal teams (Service, ITO, OTR, Finance, Design team, etc.). Drive employee engagement activities to ensure retention, recognizing success, sharing best practices, providing exposure to senior leaders within the Region and Headquarters. Drives performance management within the team, providing a regular mechanism of feedbacks. Regularly provides updates to team on company, region product strategies and customer insights. Act as a role model for collaborative mindset across functions, facilitate effective communication & trustful collaboration within the Zone/Product matrix organization.. Required Qualifications Grounded, solid experience in healthcare industry with track record in Sales functions. Solid experience in people management, leadership skills, as well as sales coaching & team building skills. Strong business acumen and data interpretation; negotiation and financial skills. Strong leadership capabilities, including strategic planning and execution, influencing skills. High level presentation and interpersonal skills; able to communicate and present ideas to customers in a way that produces understanding and impact that builds effective strategic relationships. Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport, collaboration and influence at all levels within an organization. Act as inspirational leader with optimism, highly approachable and humble. Ability to operate effectively in a multi-tasking, dynamic environment, while maintaining a forward-thinking and customer-first attitude. Excellent oral and written communications skills in English and Italian Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple details and deadlines. Education to Bachelor/Master Degree level (preferred). For this application we also evaluate candidates who meet the requirements set out in the art. 1 or belonging to the protected categories referred to in art. 18 of law 68/99 Inclusion and Diversity GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Behaviors We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity. Total Rewards Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description La risorsa verrà inserita all'interno dell' Ufficio Marketing e, operando in costante sinergia con il team interno, l' R&D e i fornitori, si occuperà della gestione e del ciclo di vita dei prodotti, dal concept iniziale fino al monitoraggio sul mercato. Principali Responsabilità Sviluppo e lancio di nuovi prodotti (NPD) in stretta collaborazione con il reparto R&D e i fornitori. Gestione del posizionamento di mercato e strategia di valorizzazione dei brand aziendali. Analisi della concorrenza (benchmarking) e conduzione di ricerche sul consumatore finale e trend di settore. Pianificazione e implementazione delle attività di comunicazione e delle strategie di promozione nei punti vendita (trade marketing / canale farmacia ed erboristeria). Formazione tecnica della rete di vendita in merito ai prodotti già presenti in portfolio e alle novità di canale. Requirements Requisiti : Laurea in ambito scientifico (Biotecnologie, Chimica e Tecnologia Farmaceutiche - CTF, Farmacia, Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari o affini) con competenze o solido interesse per il marketing di prodotto. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2 anni maturata come Product Manager o figure analoghe presso aziende di produzione o commercializzazione di integratori alimentari, nutraceutici o cosmesi naturale. Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese. Spiccata attitudine al problem solving, flessibilità operativa e ottima predisposizione al lavoro in team. Inquadramento Contratto: Inserimento diretto a tempo determinato per sostituzione maternità. Settore: Nutraceutico / Chimico-Farmaceutico (Integratori Alimentari). Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Customer Care Operations Lead is the essential link between the Global Customer Care Centre of Excellence (CoE) and your local market, you’ll own and manage instrument order fulfilment, customer enquiries, resolve escalated requests , and ensure every interaction meets both global standards and specific local needs and requirements. You will partner across commercial, service, supply chain, and customer care functions to drive customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while balancing global processes with local market needs and contribute to team training, making a meaningful impact on our customers, partners, and business every day. This is an onsite role in Buccinasco, Italy. In This Role You Will Have The Opportunity To Oversee complex instrument installations, relocations, deinstallations, backlog execution, , supplier coordination, forecasting, invoicing and regional supply chain requirements to ensure seamless customer delivery. Serve as the regional contact for customer enquiries, escalation support leveraging Voice of Customer insights, operational data, and trend analysis to resolve issues, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver successful outcomes. Partner with Sales, Service, Contracts, Tenders, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and other stakeholders to remove barriers, improve operational performance, and enhance the end-to-end customer experience. Monitor performance metrics, identify trends, implement process improvements, and balance global standards with local business requirements to improve efficiency, service delivery, and business results. Act as the Customer Care Center of Excellence (CoE) market representative, translating regional needs into global improvements while supporting business continuity, training, knowledge sharing, and process standardization across teams. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor's degree or equivalent extensive experience in customer-facing roles with a strong understanding of Customer Care processes, customer escalation management, quality practices, and continuous improvement methodologies to ensure consistent service delivery. Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex situations, apply sound judgment, and drive customer issues and escalations to timely resolution through a structured, solution-oriented approach. Proven experience coordinating across multiple functions, building strong relationships, and working effectively within a matrix organization to deliver business results and exceptional customer experiences. Ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, think critically under pressure, and adapt quickly to changing business needs while maintaining a positive and professional attitude. Job Description If you are a Sales professional looking for an opportunity to grow your career, this is a compelling leadership role where you will shape the direction and performance of Emerson’s Pressure Management business in Italy. Based in Seregno, Italy, this role supports a national scope with full responsibility for setting direction, driving sales transformation and delivering above-market growth. Reporting to the Vice President Italy, you will be accountable not only for business performance, but also for building, developing and inspiring a high-performing, engaged and future-ready sales organization, while leading change and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and innovation. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Define and execute strategies that drive long-term business growth and strengthen customer partnerships in close collaboration with business units. Lead, coach, and develop a diverse sales team to achieve and exceed annual bookings and growth targets while building future-ready capabilities. Enhance and transform sales processes, including the use of customer relationship management tools, digital solutions, and go-to-market strategies aligned with the Pressure Management value creation approach. Own the POR (President’s Operating Report) and budgeting process for bookings, margin, SG&A and headcount, including ongoing performance monitoring and reporting. Set clear goals and expectations, provide continuous feedback, and support development through structured performance and growth plans. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers both for Nat Gas Business and PRV / Regulators Business and represent Emerson in strategic commercial discussions. Collaborate across functions and business units to maximize growth opportunities, including strategic accounts and project pursuits. Contribute as an active member of the Italy leadership team, helping shape business strategy, talent development, and regional collaboration. Strengthen team capability through structured learning and development initiatives. Ensure effective governance, including delegation of authority and pricing processes. Foster an inclusive, accountable, and psychologically safe environment that encourages engagement, continuous improvement, and innovation. Ensure full compliance with quality, health, safety, environmental, and trade standards across all activities. Who You Are: You paint a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action and inspires commitment. You consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances, by maintaining focus and accountability. You anticipate and balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while building strong relationships and trust. You apply knowledge of the business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals and identify new opportunities for growth. For This Role, You Will Need: Demonstrated experience (minimum 10 years) leading sales teams, with a strong focus on developing people, fostering engagement, and delivering consistent performance. Proven ability to drive structured sales management practices, including pipeline management, forecasting, and performance analysis. Proven P&L and margin accountability, balancing profitability and price discipline with volume growth Experience working across industries such as energy, power, refining, life sciences, or chemicals with a strong understanding of automation, pressure management solutions or other engineered industrial technologies. Strong demonstrated experience and results with Companies of the Public Sector in Italy and also Original Equipment Manufactures (OEM). Capability to lead transformation efforts, including adoption of digital tools and new ways of working to improve productivity and customer outcomes. Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to develop long-term, trust-based partnerships with customers. Experience collaborating within a matrix environment and aligning cross-functional teams to execute growth strategies. Ability to navigate change, prioritize effectively, and take ownership in a dynamic and evolving business environment. Fluency in Italian and English language (written and spoken); Openness to travel on national and international level as needed. Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: Bachelor’s Degree qualification in engineering, business management, or a related subject area. Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives - because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefit plans to meet yours and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide wellbeing benefits, healthcare plans and eyecare, benefits centered around professional development, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our compensation philosophy is simple: we pay a competitive base salary, within the local market in which we operate, and reward performance during our annual merit review process. The total compensation for this role is 97600 EUR to 139400 EUR annually, commensurate with the skills, talent, capabilities, and experience each candidate brings to a role. For roles covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the applicable salary range and pay structure are set by that agreement, including how pay levels and progression are defined ( Contratto Commercio - Manageritalia ). About Us WHY EMERSON Our Commitment to Our People At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together. About Emerson Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety. We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go! No calls or agencies please. Founded in Jena in 1846 , today ZEISS is a global company with more than 48,000 employees across around 50 countries, driving innovation in research, medical technology, quality assurance and consumer products. As the pioneer of science in optics , we continue to challenge the limits of our imagination. For our Research Quality Solutions business unit, which delivers end-to-end solutions for industrial metrology in both laboratory and production environments , we are looking for a Software Sales Manager to accelerate the growth of our stand-alone software business across EMEA, starting with Italy. In this role, you will focus strongly on the PIWEB software suite , one of our key solutions for data management and reporting, capable of significantly improving performance and quality across manufacturing processes. What will you be responsible for? Managing the full sales cycle of the PIWEB software solution Developing the Italian market, including Italian-speaking Switzerland as the launch region for EMEA expansion Identifying new high-potential customers across industrial sectors and beyond Leading complex decision-making processes involving stakeholders from Operations, Quality, IT, Digital, and top management Applying a value-selling approach, translating software capabilities into tangible customer benefits Building and managing a solid pipeline, including multi-plant projects, in close collaboration with internal pre-sales, application, and project management teams, as well as with corporate teams What does it take to succeed in this role? Technical or scientific educational background (technical diploma or university degree) At least 8 years of experience in enterprise software sales related to manufacturing, quality, data, and processes (MES, PLM, QMS, CAQ) Strong knowledge of industrial IT ecosystems (data, traceability, integrations, digital architectures) A consultative approach and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders (COO, CEO, Heads of Operations and Quality, IT Managers) Team-oriented mindset, both in project environments and client management Excellent active listening, negotiation, and end-to-end customer management skills, even in complex and fast-changing scenarios A strong “hunter” mindset combined with a structured and professional approach Willingness to take on challenging opportunities and thrive in dynamic, evolving environments What we offer Employment terms: Permanent contract under the Italian Collective Agreement Terziario Confcommercio, annual gross salary range Euro 55.000-60.000 plus a variable component based on target achievement. Benefits: Company car, meal vouchers, corporate welfare benefits, LinkedIn Learning license, and a range of wellbeing initiatives, including counseling services, wellbeing-focused sessions and company events designed to foster engagement and a sense of belonging. Preferred location : Milan area or nearby Scope : Developing the Italian market and Italian-speaking Switzerland as the starting point for broader EMEA expansion (occasional travel to headquarters and other European countries) Language requirements : Fluent in English (both written and spoken) Start date : as soon as the right candidate is identified Next Steps Once we receive your CV, we will take the time to carefully review your application. If your profile matches this or another opportunity within the ZEISS Group, we will get in touch with you to take the next step and get to know each other. Otherwise, we will be happy to keep your CV in our database and consider your profile for future opportunities. Non proponiamo offerte standard: lavoriamo con un approccio consulenziale per costruire soluzioni personalizzate che rispondano davvero alle esigenze dei clienti, combinando analisi dei consumi, controllo dei costi, fotovoltaico, efficienza energetica e smart building. In FuturEnergy la vendita parte dall'ascolto: il nostro obiettivo è individuare le esigenze energetiche di ogni cliente e proporre soluzioni realmente in linea con le sue necessità. Senior Associate - Deal Transformation - Strategy & Operations -  - 10123 - Deloitte Italia Skip to content Deloitte Italia Search jobs Italy Greece Malta Login Current language English - US Senior Associate - Deal Transformation - Strategy & Operations Job Specs Job Name Senior Associate - Deal Transformation - Strategy & Operations Location Milano, Roma Business Area STRATEGY & TRANSACTIONS Seniority Experienced Business Function STRATEGY, RISK & TRANSACTIONS ADVISORY What impact will you make? Senior Associate - Deal Transformation Strategy & Operations Stiamo cercando una figura Senior Associate da inserire nel team Deal Transformation & Post Merger Integration di Deloitte nella sede di Milano e Roma che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid. Il team di Deal Transformation, appartenente all'area di Monitor Deloitte , affianca i clienti in ogni fase di una operazione M&A, dalla fase pre-deal con business e operational due diligence a supporto della decisione di investimento, fino alla creazione di valore post-deal tramite integrazione e iniziative di performance improvement. Your Role I n quanto Senior Associate avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con il Top Management delle aziende clienti, focalizzandoti su tematiche di Pre Deal e Post Deal all’interno di operazioni di finanza straordinaria (M&A). Nello specifico, la risorsa si occuperà di: M&A Integration & Separation Svolgere attività di separation due diligence/ assessment , analizzando la complessità della separation, la standalone readiness, le implicazioni operative e organizzative, i requisiti di TSA, gli stranded costs e i principali rischi di execution Supportare il design e l’execution di programmi complessi di M&A integration e separation , dalla preparazione alla Day 1 fino alla fase di post-closing, inclusa la gestione degli Integration/Separation Management Offices (IMO/SMO). Supportare il design e l’implementazione delle strategie di integration e separation , degli standalone e target operating models, delle strutture di governance, dei Day 1 e Day 100 plans e delle execution roadmaps. Coordinare i c ross-functional workstreams , monitorando interdipendenze, rischi e critical decisions e assicurando la corretta gestione delle criticità secondo gli escalation paths definiti. Value Creation Gestire l’intero processo di synergy assessment, dalla identificazione delle opportunità di sinergia alla loro quantificazione , dall’implementation planning al value capture, con l’obiettivo di massimizzare la realizzazione delle sinergie previste dalle operazioni di M&A. I dentificare e quantificare one-off costs, dis-synergies, stranded costs e value leakage , definendo azioni di mitigazione e supportando il cost management. Supportare lo sviluppo di business cases e value creation initiatives , valutandone l’impatto economico e operativo. Sviluppare modelli di tracking per monitorare l’avanzamento delle value creation initiatives e la realizzazione del valore rispetto ai business cases e ai target, identificando variances, risks e opportunities. Programme Management & Governance Strutturare e gestire programmi complessi , definendo l’integrated plan, i meccanismi di governance e gli strumenti di monitoraggio e gestione delle criticità, inclusi RAID e decision logs. Monitorare l’avanzamento del programma , verificando milestone, rischi e interdipendenze e gestendo le principali criticità attraverso gli opportuni escalation paths. Predisporre reporting package per il Top Management e gli Steering Committee , sintetizzando stato di avanzamento, principali rischi e criticità e le decisioni richieste. Facilitare gli incontri di governance, workshop e working sessions con senior client stakeholders e functional teams , favorendo l’allineamento tra le diverse funzioni e supportando il processo decisionale. Stakeholder Management Costruire e gestire relazioni solide con client executives e functional leaders , comprendendone esigenze e priorità e assicurando un efficace coinvolgimento nelle diverse fasi del programma Collaborare con team Deloitte multidisciplinari per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni integrate per i clienti e individuare nuove opportunità commerciali. Favorire una collaborazione efficace tra client teams e Deloitte professionals, garantendo l'allineamento tra workstreams, stakeholders e programme priorities. Presentare analisi e raccomandazioni a senior management, C-level executives e Steering Committee , comunicando in modo chiaro i principali elementi di valutazione e supportando il processo decisionale. What we offer La retribuzione fissa prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra  EUR 60.000 e EUR 65.000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Associate . L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi. La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. Winning Requirements 4-5 anni di esperienza professionale in management consulting, transaction advisory, business transformation e/o M&A Integration & Separation,. Buona conoscenza del M&A lifecycle e delle principali sfide operative e organizzative legate a integration, separation e corporate transformation , maturata attraverso il coinvolgimento nella gestione di programmi di Post-Merger Integration, Separation, Carve-out e/o large-scale transformation. Capacità di gestire functional workstreams , coordinando le attività e le principali interdipendenze e supportando l’execution di programmi complessi. Solide capacità di quantitative e business analysis , con la capacità di sviluppare analisi e contribuire a business cases, synergy assessments e value creation initiatives, traducendo i risultati in elementi utili alle raccomandazioni. Buone capacità di project e stakeholder management , con capacità di gestire molteplici attività e priorità, interagire con client stakeholders e coordinarsi efficacemente con team multidisciplinari. Disponibilità a lavorare in trasferta presso il cliente (anche all’estero); Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata. Make An Impact That Matters Deloitte è un network leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, presente in oltre 150 Paesi con 457 mila professionisti. Offriamo soluzioni innovative e sostenibili in Audit & Assurance, Strategy, Risk & Transaction Advisory, Tax & Legal e Technology & Transformation. Il nostro obiettivo è supportare le aziende nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie al passo con il mercato. In Deloitte la sostenibilità è un tema centrale. Per questo, attraverso le strategie e le progettualità legate alle tematiche Environmental, Social e Governance (ESG), ci impegniamo a promuovere una crescita responsabile, sostenibile e inclusiva per il Pianeta, le nostre persone e la società. Scopri di più sulle nostre strategie di Corporate Sustainability, tra cui Well-being, la strategia volta a migliorare il benessere fisico, mentale e sociale delle nostre persone, affinché siano felici e piene di energia in tutti gli ambiti della loro vita e WorldClimate, la strategia globale di Deloitte per diventare un’organizzazione Net Zero e per guidare scelte responsabili all’interno e all’esterno dell’organizzazione. Sei pront* a #MakeAnImpactThatMatter insieme? Candidati ora! Segnala offerta di lavoro Informazioni sull’offerta di lavoro LMDV Hospitality Group è la divisione del gruppo LMDV Capital, holding di Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio, nata con l’obiettivo di offrire un approccio a 360° al mondo dell’hospitality, della ristorazione e dell’intrattenimento di alta gamma. Il gruppo unisce fine dining e luxury hospitality attraverso l’integrazione dei brand Vesta, Casa Fiori Chiari, Trattoria del Ciumbia con l’iconico Twiga Group , dando vita a un ecosistema che fonde lifestyle, entertainment e cucina d’eccellenza. Con una visione ambiziosa e una strategia di crescita di lungo periodo, LMDV Hospitality Group è impegnato nella creazione di destinazioni iconiche in Italia e all’estero, dove design, qualità del servizio e attenzione alle persone sono al centro di ogni esperienza. Far parte del nostro gruppo vuol dire contribuire ogni giorno a offrire esperienze di alto livello, in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione. Siamo alla ricerca di un/a Head of Growth & Performance , per unirsi al nostro team corporate a Milano! La figura avrà l'obiettivo di supportare la crescita del business attraverso un approccio data-driven, integrando strategie di marketing, revenue management e customer intelligence, con particolare attenzione alla conversione, alla marginalità e alla valorizzazione del cliente. Lavorerà trasversalmente sui diversi brand e venue del Gruppo, in stretta collaborazione con i team Marketing, Operations, Finance e Reservation. Responsabilità principali Growth e strategia digitale e commerciale: definire e sviluppare strategie di crescita a partire dall'analisi delle performance e delle priorità commerciali delle singole venue e tipologie di evento. Monitorare le booking window, individuando tempestivamente le opportunità di intervento e ottimizzando l'allocazione degli investimenti tra brand, venue e canali di acquisizione. Performance Marketing e coordinamento delle agenzie: definire obiettivi, priorità e indicazioni strategiche per le agenzie esterne, monitorando l'efficacia delle campagne e allocando dinamicamente i budget in funzione delle esigenze commerciali e dei risultati ottenuti. Revenue Management & Pricing: analizzare i fattori che influenzano la conversione, distinguendo le opportunità legate alla visibilità da quelle relative al prodotto, al pricing e alle condizioni commerciali. Contribuire alla definizione delle strategie di prezzo, minimum spend e politiche di accesso, simulandone l'impatto su conversione, fatturato e marginalità in collaborazione con Operations e Finance. Customer Acquisition & Retention: sviluppare strategie finalizzate alla riduzione del Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) e all'incremento del Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), attraverso una migliore allocazione degli investimenti e iniziative mirate di retention e fidelizzazione. Customer & Marketing Intelligence: analizzare i comportamenti e le caratteristiche dei diversi cluster di clientela, identificando opportunità di crescita e valorizzazione dei clienti ad alto valore. Valutare lo sviluppo di programmi loyalty, membership e altre iniziative di fidelizzazione, stimandone l'impatto incrementale e monitorandone i risultati. Performance, Data & Reporting: definire dashboard e sistemi di monitoraggio delle performance commerciali e di marketing, attraverso l'analisi dei principali KPI, tra cui CAC, LTV, Conversion Rate, ROAS, Booking Window e Repeat Rate. Attribution & Business Intelligence: sviluppare, in collaborazione con Reservation e Finance, un sistema di attribuzione che consenta di misurare il contributo effettivo dei diversi canali e delle attività di marketing alla generazione di prenotazioni e fatturato. Strategia e collaborazione cross-funzionale: tradurre dati e insight in azioni concrete, supportando i diversi team nella definizione delle priorità operative e commerciali e contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di crescita del Gruppo. Requisiti specifici Consolidata esperienza in ruoli di Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, Revenue Management o Digital Strategy. Forte orientamento al business e ai risultati, con capacità di collegare le strategie di marketing alle performance commerciali ed economiche. Ottima conoscenza delle principali metriche di acquisizione, conversione, retention e marginalità. Esperienza nella gestione e nell'ottimizzazione di budget di Digital e Performance Marketing. Competenze in ambito customer segmentation, customer intelligence e modelli di attribuzione. Ottima capacità di analisi dei dati e familiarità con strumenti di analytics, reporting e Business Intelligence. Capacità di coordinare agenzie e partner esterni, definendo obiettivi e monitorandone le performance. Approccio strategico, proattivo e analitico, accompagnato da una forte capacità di execution. Capacità di lavorare trasversalmente con diverse funzioni aziendali in contesti dinamici, multibrand e in forte crescita. Costituirà titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nei settori Hospitality, Luxury, Entertainment, Travel, Retail o in business caratterizzati da elevati volumi di prenotazioni e transazioni digitali. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. A diretto riporto del Direttore Generale, guiderai l’esecuzione della strategia commerciale, sviluppando priorità di mercato, partnership e modelli di go-to-market scalabili. In sinergia con le funzioni aziendali, supporterai la crescita internazionale e la commercializzazione delle tecnologie Enivibes nei settori Oil & Gas, energia, utilities e infrastrutture. Attività Principali Elaborare proposte di strategia commerciale e assicurarne l’esecuzione Analizzare mercati, trend, clienti e concorrenti, supportando la segmentazione e la definizione delle priorità commerciali Sviluppare nuovi mercati, canali commerciali e partnership coerenti con gli obiettivi aziendali Assicurare la governance commerciale dei partner strategici e il coordinamento delle iniziative congiunte Definire i modelli di go-to-market per le nuove tecnologie Coordinare le attività di business development e marketing commerciale, indirizzandole verso i mercati e le opportunità prioritarie Definire e migliorare il processo commerciale, dalla generazione e qualificazione delle opportunità fino all’offerta, alla negoziazione e all’handover verso Operations Assicurare l’ownership e la governance del CRM, garantendo qualità, completezza e aggiornamento delle informazioni Consolidare il forecast commerciale verificandone coerenza, completezza e affidabilità, monitorando a livello consolidato pipeline, ordini, ricavi, marginalità e principali KPI commerciali Elaborare pricing policy e modelli commerciali coerenti con il posizionamento delle tecnologie e con gli obiettivi di sostenibilità economica dell’azienda Supportare Sales & Account Management nella predisposizione delle offerte strategiche e nella definizione delle proposte di valore Promuovere metodi, strumenti e modalità operative orientati alla commercial excellence e alla scalabilità della funzione commerciale Rappresentare Enivibes, quando richiesto, in incontri con clienti, partner, associazioni, eventi e conferenze nazionali e internazionali Caratteristiche Richieste Laurea magistrale, preferibilmente in Ingegneria o Economia. Descrizione azienda FuturEnergy è una realtà specializzata nello sviluppo di soluzioni di forniture energetiche su misura per Piccole e Medie Imprese e clienti residenziali. Non proponiamo offerte standard: lavoriamo con un approccio consulenziale per costruire soluzioni personalizzate che rispondano davvero alle esigenze dei clienti, combinando analisi dei consumi, controllo dei costi, fotovoltaico, efficienza energetica e smart building. Siamo un'azienda in continua crescita, costruita su competenza, innovazione e valorizzazione delle persone. Crediamo che i risultati nascano dal talento, dalla determinazione e dalla possibilità di lavorare in un contesto che riconosce davvero il valore di chi contribuisce alla crescita dell'azienda. Posizione Il prossimo passo della tua carriera? Guidare la crescita di un territorio. FuturEnergy ricerca un/una Responsabile commerciale a cui affidare il coordinamento e lo sviluppo della propria rete commerciale sul territorio. Cerchiamo un professionista capace di valorizzare le persone, individuare nuove opportunità di business e contribuire attivamente al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali. Il ruolo prevede una collaborazione diretta con la Direzione Commerciale , con la possibilità di partecipare alle strategie di crescita dell'area assegnata. Il progetto che intendiamo condividere Avrai la responsabilità di sviluppare e consolidare la presenza commerciale di FuturEnergy sul territorio, occupandoti di: Sviluppo della rete: ricerca, selezione e inserimento di nuovi consulenti commerciali; Coordinamento del team: gestione e valorizzazione delle risorse della rete vendita; Formazione: accompagnamento dei consulenti nel percorso di crescita attraverso la nostra Academy; Raggiungimento degli obiettivi: monitoraggio delle attività e supporto al team per il conseguimento dei risultati; Concrete opportunità di crescita e sviluppo: individuazione di nuove opportunità commerciali e strategie di sviluppo. Requisiti Il profilo che stiamo cercando Ci rivolgiamo a professionisti con una forte attitudine alla leadership, capacità di pianificazione e visione strategica. Cosa Cerchiamo etica professionale e ambizione; esperienza nel coordinamento e nella crescita di reti commerciali; capacità di lavorare in autonomia e organizzare le attività; conoscenza del settore energetico o di mercati affini, considerata un plus ma non indispensabile. Benefit Programma di riconoscimenti e premi Viaggi premio / Incentivi aziendali Altre informazioni Una struttura commerciale a supporto dei tuoi risultati Entrare in FuturEnergy significa poter contare su strumenti, condizioni e opportunità pensati per sostenere concretamente lo sviluppo della tua area. Cosa Offriamo mandato diretto; trattamento economico con fisso, variabile e incentivi; possibilità di auto aziendale; offerte commerciali profilate e competitive per l'intero portafoglio potenziale business (micro PMI e industry); possibilità di proporre offerte personalizzate; procedure di analisi creditizia dirette e snelle; possibilità di conclusione contratto da remoto con firma OTP; strumenti di lead generation e sistemi di referral; opportunità concrete di crescita in ambito manageriale. Costruiamo collaborazioni solide e durature , valorizzando autonomia, competenze e risultati. Diventa essere protagonista dello sviluppo della nostra rete commerciale? To provide better services to meet the growing demand in the international telecommunications market, CMI has expanded its footprint in 38 countries and regions. Leveraging the strong support by China Mobile, CMI is a trusted partner that provides comprehensive international telecom services and solutions to international enterprises, carriers and mobile users. China Mobile Italy office is recruiting a Business Development Manager (M/F) who will be in charge of prospecting and developing our business on the Enterprise market. Main missions Prospecting, detecting and identifying business opportunities. Establish a portfolio of enterprise customers Establish new customer relationships and explore potential business opportunities Develop and execute sales strategies to approach new customers and detect new opportunities to maximize sales prospects and market penetration Escalate customer needs and issues to the relevant technical teams Promote China Mobile's products and solutions to customers by organizing or participating in activities such as workshops, trade shows, and promotional campaigns Manage and respond to calls for tenders (BID management), mobilize internal resources to prepare offers and respond in a way that is adapted to customer needs Develop the commercial proposal by coordinating the activities of the various internal contributors: technical, financial, legal... ABOUT ZENOBE Our mission is to make clean power accessible. We are passionate about making a positive impact on communities and the environment where we work. We’re designing, financing, building and operating the world’s most sophisticated battery systems to enable the take up of more renewable power, electrifying fleets for cleaner air, and providing clean, portable power including repurposed electric vehicle batteries. Our proprietary software and data analysis optimises operational performance for our customers to reduce emissions and costs. Since we began in 2017, we’ve raised over £2.7 billion in debt and equity funding and transformed it into >1.2GW of grid-connected batteries live or under contract and c.3,400 electric vehicles supported. We have operations in the UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and the US and Canada, with a global headquarters in London. We’re the leading owner and operator of battery storage in the UK, supporting the National Grid with the uptake of renewable power. We also work with c.90% of the UK's major bus companies, powering 25% of the UK e-bus market. We’re also the number one owner and operator of e-buses in Australia and New Zealand, and are quickly expanding into light commercial vehicles and trucks. Our rapidly growing company is looking for highly talented and motivated people to join us. THE OPPORTUNITY We are looking to recruit a Business Development Director with experience in the (electrified) Transport and / or Leasing market to establish and grow the EV business in Italy. This is a market entry role: the successful candidate will set the Italian strategy, drive the build of the local commercial infrastructure, partnerships and capabilities, and own the country’s commercial performance. The candidate will ideally bring a good understanding of the (public) transportation sector with a focus on depot-based commercial fleets such as buses and trucks. The candidate will be able to oversee the day-to-day aspects of the project development and financing process from origination to contract closure. The role integrates with team members in finance, legal, commercial, engineering and construction to put together complex, high-value, long-term contracts and solutions. The role includes liaising with clients and external stakeholders and will be responsible for the growth from a business and headcount perspective, recruiting and scaling the local team whilst working closely with international colleagues across the wider Zenobē group. It will be a requirement to hit the ground running and to be comfortable operating at a rapid pace at times with high levels of ambiguity and the pressure of deadlines. A TASTE OF THE DAY TO DAY Leading origination and development of EV projects and customer relationships with bus operators, other fleet operators and municipal transit authorities Defining and executing the Italian market entry strategy, including target segments, go-to-market approach, local partnerships and the commercial and operational set-up required to establish the business Owning the Italian P&L, including annual budget, revenue and margin targets, pipeline development and regular performance reporting to the leadership team Developing compelling propositions and competitive bids Monitoring and responding to Italian public tenders for zero-emission bus fleets and charging infrastructure, including procedures under the Public Contracts Code (D.Lgs. 36/2023) and on e-procurement platforms such as MEPA/Consip and regional purchasing bodies, and tracking national and EU funding programmes relevant to fleet electrification Structuring contracts for long-term leasing and fleet electrification transactions, and negotiating terms through to financial close with internal finance and legal teams, lenders and investors Sponsoring high quality internal InvestCom papers Developing strategic partnerships with vehicle OEMs, charger manufacturers and technical consultants, regulators, utilities, banks, investors and public authorities (regions, municipalities and local transport agencies) to support the scaling of the business Take the lead to have financial models ready for Italian market Developing sales and marketing materials, speaking at and attending conferences as appropriate Being a public face of the firm for fleets helping manage client relationships Working collaboratively with Zenobē’s international teams in finance, legal, engineering and operations. Leading, driving and mentoring a successful Sales function across Italy, ensuring individual and team targets are met in line with agreed objectives Health and Safety Actively contribute to Zenobe's commitment to health and safety, wellbeing and sustainability by; integrating these principles into daily responsibilities, ensuring a safe and supportive work environment, promoting both the physical and mental health of self and colleagues, and adopting sustainable and energy-efficient practices to minimize environmental impact. By doing so, each employee at Zenobe plays a vital role in fostering a culture that prioritises overall safety, holistic wellbeing, environmental sustainability in our business operations. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR We realise that certain groups of people are less likely to apply for a role if they don’t meet 100% of the job requirements. To be absolutely clear: if you like the look of this job and think you could do it well, we encourage you to apply with a CV that highlights your transferable skills and experience. Above all, Zenobē is looking for collaborative, flexible, empathetic people who are interested in creating and promoting practical routes to a zero carbon world. Essential competencies: Fluency in English and Italian; Spanish language is a nice-to-have A proven leader and salesperson who is driven to close deals and hit targets High quality education (bachelor’s degree or masters) preferably in engineering or finance related A genuine passion in clean energy and our social and environmental mission Solid work experience (10+ years) in commercial / business development, preferably in the transport sector and with electrification experience A demonstrable track record of entering a new market or establishing a business, business unit or country operation from an early stage Experience owning a P&L or country-level commercial targets, budgets and pipeline An existing network of customers in the bus/fleet space and credibility operating at a senior level with transport operators, OEMs, utilities, investors and public authorities Strong commercial skills, comfortable with legal contracts, project development and financing, with a track record of originating and closing complex, long-term leasing or infrastructure financing transactions Knowledge of Italian public procurement rules and tender processes, with experience preparing and submitting bids through public procurement platforms Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting financial analysis and sales pitches Strong organisation skills, team player and good attention to detail An entrepreneurial leader with a growth mindset and experience building teams, and working effectively within an international, matrixed organisation Results oriented and accountable, able to deliver within budget Ability to travel across Italy frequently WORKING AT ZENOBE We’re passionate about sustainability and are proud to offer Team Zenobē a pioneering and collaborative working environment. We encourage our people to take ownership of their career progression and celebrate those that can think outside the box. If you’d like to join our community of likeminded people hit the apply button now, we’d love to hear from you! Lots of our people work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time, flexitime and hybrid working. We can’t promise to give you exactly what you want, but please talk to us about the flexibility you need and let’s see how we can make it work. OUR APPROACH TO DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION Our people are our strongest asset and the key determinant of our success, and we value a range of skillsets and perspectives. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We work to provide equal opportunities and an inclusive work environment, where everyone is fairly treated in the application process and through their career at Zenobē. If there are any adjustments that would help improve your experience with Zenobē, please let us know when you apply.
