Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro L'OPPORTUNITÀ Siamo alla ricerca di un Business Development Director con esperienza nel mercato del trasporto (elettrificato) e/o del leasing, per avviare e far crescere il business EV in Italia. Si tratta di un ruolo di ingresso nel mercato: la persona selezionata definirà la strategia per l'Italia, guiderà la costruzione dell'infrastruttura commerciale, delle partnership e delle competenze locali e sarà responsabile della performance commerciale del Paese. Il candidato ideale avrà una buona conoscenza del settore del trasporto (pubblico), con particolare attenzione alle flotte commerciali con ricarica in deposito, come autobus e camion. Il candidato sarà in grado di supervisionare gli aspetti operativi quotidiani del processo di sviluppo e finanziamento dei progetti, dall'origination fino alla chiusura del contratto. Il ruolo si integra con i colleghi di finanza, area legale, area commerciale, ingegneria e costruzione, per mettere a punto contratti e soluzioni complessi, di alto valore e di lungo termine. Il ruolo prevede il dialogo con clienti e stakeholder esterni e la responsabilità della crescita in termini di business e di organico, attraverso il reclutamento e lo sviluppo del team locale, lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi internazionali del gruppo Zenobē. È richiesta la capacità di essere operativi fin da subito e di lavorare a ritmi sostenuti, talvolta in presenza di un elevato grado di ambiguità e sotto la pressione delle scadenze. UNA PANORAMICA DELL'ATTIVITÀ QUOTIDIANA Guidare l'origination e lo sviluppo di progetti EV e le relazioni con i clienti, tra cui operatori di autobus, altri operatori di flotte e autorità del trasporto pubblico locale Definire ed eseguire la strategia di ingresso nel mercato italiano, inclusi i segmenti target, l'approccio go-to-market, le partnership locali e l'assetto commerciale e operativo necessario per costituire il business Essere responsabile del conto economico (P&L) per l'Italia, inclusi budget annuale, obiettivi di ricavi e marginalità, sviluppo della pipeline e reportistica periodica sulle performance al team di leadership Sviluppare proposte commerciali convincenti e offerte competitive Monitorare e partecipare alle gare pubbliche italiane per flotte di autobus a zero emissioni e infrastrutture di ricarica, incluse le procedure previste dal Codice dei contratti pubblici (D.Lgs. 36/2023) e le piattaforme di e-procurement come MEPA/Consip e le centrali di committenza regionali, e seguire i programmi di finanziamento nazionali ed europei rilevanti per l'elettrificazione delle flotte Strutturare i contratti per operazioni di leasing a lungo termine ed elettrificazione di flotte e negoziarne i termini fino al financial close, insieme ai team interni di finanza e legale, ai finanziatori e agli investitori Sponsorizzare documenti InvestCom interni di alta qualità Sviluppare partnership strategiche con i costruttori di veicoli (OEM), i produttori di sistemi di ricarica, i consulenti tecnici, le autorità di regolazione, le utility, le banche, gli investitori e le amministrazioni pubbliche (regioni, comuni e agenzie per la mobilità locale), a supporto della crescita del business Assumere la guida nella predisposizione dei modelli finanziari per il mercato italiano Sviluppare materiali commerciali e di marketing, intervenire e partecipare a conferenze, ove opportuno Rappresentare l'azienda come volto pubblico nel settore delle flotte, contribuendo alla gestione delle relazioni con i clienti Collaborare con i team internazionali di Zenobē nelle aree finanza, legale, ingegneria e operations. Guidare, orientare e fare da mentore a una funzione Vendite efficace in tutta Italia, assicurando il raggiungimento degli obiettivi individuali e di team in linea con quanto concordato SALUTE E SICUREZZA Contribuire attivamente all'impegno di Zenobe per la salute e la sicurezza, il benessere e la sostenibilità, integrando questi principi nelle proprie responsabilità quotidiane, garantendo un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e di supporto, promuovendo la salute fisica e mentale propria e dei colleghi e adottando pratiche sostenibili ed efficienti dal punto di vista energetico per ridurre al minimo l'impatto ambientale. Job Description The Director, Power Train Technical Business Development leads Vertiv’s pre-sales technical engagement for power infrastructure solutions across global strategic Hyperscale, Neo-Cloud, and MTDC customers. This is a critical role bridging deep electrical power domain expertise with customer-facing influence to position Vertiv as the basis of design for power architectures in mission-critical data center environments. The scope encompasses the full power train — from utility entrance through medium voltage switchgear, transformers, UPS systems (AC and DC), static transfer switches, power distribution (PDUs, RPPs, busway), and battery/energy storage systems. As data center campuses scale to hundreds of megawatts and AI workloads demand unprecedented power density and reliability, this role is at the forefront of defining how Vertiv addresses next-generation power challenges. The Technical Business Development team positions Vertiv as a trusted partner through deep product and solution expertise, industry insight & leadership, and customer consultation to design solutions that meet customers’ unique needs. The goal is to “get up and to the left” – engaging higher in the customer organization to the decision maker level and earlier in the process to position Vertiv as the basis of design. The incumbent guides a team of power domain experts with credible technical capability and strong communication and influence skills. Strong collaboration and partnership with the Hyperscale, Neocloud, and MTDC account managers, data center solutions, thermal chain, and whitespace solutions teams are critical to deliver a consistent and unified message to advance Vertiv’s market position. This position requires invention on a daily basis with a keen sense of urgency and market approach nimbleness. Today’s data center customers expect speed and technical competence in addressing power challenges at scale — particularly as campuses grow to GW-scale and customers explore alternative power architectures including DC distribution and on-site generation. SUCCESS MEASURES Power Basis-of-Design: Achievement of Vertiv power products/solutions as customer basis-of-design across power architectures (AC, DC, hybrid, modular power). Share-of-Wallet Penetration: Measurable orders & sales share gain for power train solutions at target GSA customers. Thought Leadership: Collaboration with Power BU/Product Lines to develop reference power architectures and disseminate power train thought leadership to customers, industry events, and market publications. Account Strategy: Collaboration with GSA and NAM Sales counterparts to define and execute power-specific growth strategies within overall account plans. Capability Maturity: Expansion of team capabilities; evolution from product-specific power skills to system-level power train expertise integrated with overall data center architecture. Responsibilities Customer Technical Engagement: Lead technical engagement with identified and emerging GSA customers to influence and design power architectures positioning Vertiv’s power portfolio as the basis of design. Collaborate directly with strategic GSA customers to design overall power strategies addressing current and future capacity, density, and reliability requirements. Whiteboard system-level power architectures with customer CTOs, Engineering, and Design leadership — articulating trade-offs between AC/DC topologies, redundancy levels, and modular vs. traditional approaches. Drive early engagement in the customer’s design cycle to shape power requirements before RFP issuance. Product, Systems & Solutions Expertise Deep understanding of Vertiv’s power portfolio including UPS systems (AC and DC), switchgear, PDUs, RPPs, busway, static transfer switches, battery/energy storage systems, and integrated power modules/skids. Ability to articulate system-level power design — from utility entrance to rack — including medium voltage infrastructure, paralleling, distribution topologies, monitoring/controls, and power quality. Understanding of Vertiv’s integrated power solutions such as OneCore and power modules/skids to steer opportunities toward Vertiv’s differentiated offerings. Ensure technical buyers understand Vertiv’s power capabilities; coordinate solution alignment with product roadmaps and drive innovative approaches to meet evolving capacity, efficiency, and sustainability requirements. Drive alignment and collaboration across senior leadership, sales, product development, and engineering to mature and disseminate power train thought leadership and reference designs. One Vertiv. Engage with external design firms and consulting engineers to influence power specifications. Voice-of-Customer (VOC) Capture and communicate market needs, product gaps, and emerging power trends to the Power BU and Product Lines. Drive feedback loops to shape future power products and solution strategies — particularly around DC architectures, energy storage evolution, grid integration, and sustainability requirements. Industry Engagement Represent Vertiv in trade shows, conferences, and industry publications to showcase power train technical thought leadership. Build visibility into Vertiv’s power strategic direction and reinforce its market posture in power innovation. Engage with industry bodies (IEEE, NFPA, Uptime Institute) on power standards and best practices. Team Leadership & Development Lead and mentor a team of power domain experts across assigned regions. Foster collaboration, cross-learning, and best-practice sharing across the team and with global peers. Build cross-BU technical capabilities within the team (e.g., understanding thermal and whitespace interdependencies with power design). Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or related discipline; advanced degree (MBA or MS) strongly preferred. 10+ years of progressive responsibility in technical business development, power systems/electrical solution engineering, or pre-sales leadership roles, with at least 5 years at a senior level influencing enterprise customers and shaping power solution strategy. Recognized expertise in data center power infrastructure, including UPS, distribution, and energy storage architectures, with a demonstrable record of steering power architecture decisions at global or strategic accounts. Demonstrated success translating power technical strategies into revenue growth, market share expansion, or measurable business impact. Experience collaborating directly with sales leadership to develop account strategies. Deep, hands-on understanding of data center power technologies — UPS (AC/DC), switchgear, PDUs, busway, STS, battery/BESS systems, and power monitoring/controls — combined with the ability to integrate power design within overall data center architecture. Experience leading geographically dispersed teams, aligning with global Product Lines and Business Units, and influencing senior executives across engineering, product management, and sales organizations. Established presence in industry forums, standards bodies (IEEE, NFPA, Uptime Institute), or trade publications; capable of representing Vertiv’s power direction credibly at conferences and with analysts. Exceptional ability to engage at the C-suite level with customers and to articulate a compelling technical and commercial vision to both internal and external stakeholders. Ability to travel extensively to strategic customers, regional teams, and global BU locations. This role may be performed in multiple jurisdictions. In jurisdictions subject to EU Pay Transparency requirements, a locally applicable salary range applies and will be communicated in accordance with local legal obligations, if not shown in this posting. Salary ranges for other jurisdictions may vary in line with local market conditions and applicable legislation. Segnala offerta di lavoro E-commerce Specialist – BRICO OK BRICO OK, leader nella vendita al dettaglio di articoli per il fai da te, con oltre 120 punti vendita in Italia, è alla ricerca di un/una E-commerce Specialist da inserire presso la propria Sede Centrale di Cantù (CO). Entrerai a far parte del team E-commerce, all’interno del quale ti occuperai della gestione operativa e dell’ottimizzazione del canale e-commerce, con particolare focus sul catalogo online, sull’analisi delle performance e sulle attività di back office necessarie al corretto funzionamento della piattaforma. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con le altre funzioni aziendali e con i partner tecnologici e commerciali esterni, contribuendo attivamente allo sviluppo e al miglioramento continuo del canale di vendita online e alla sua integrazione con la rete dei punti vendita fisici. Attività principali Gestione operativa del catalogo e-commerce, garantendo accuratezza, aggiornamento e qualità dei dati prodotto (descrizioni, immagini, caratteristiche tecniche, categorizzazione e attributi). Implementazione e ottimizzazione del piano commerciale e promozionale (promozioni, prezzi web-exclusive, banner, landing page e contenuti di e-merchandising). Coordinamento del calendario promozionale e supporto all’esecuzione delle campagne digitali in linea con la strategia aziendale. Analisi delle performance del sito e delle campagne (traffico, conversion rate, AOV, fatturato e andamento degli ordini) e monitoraggio dei principali KPI. Attività di benchmark e analisi della concorrenza per identificare trend e opportunità di mercato. Collaborazione con le funzioni Acquisti, Logistica e Customer Service per la gestione di stock, prezzi e problematiche operative. Monitoraggio del corretto funzionamento del sito, individuazione di anomalie e coordinamento delle attività di risoluzione con i partner tecnologici. Supporto allo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità e alle attività di test e miglioramento della piattaforma e-commerce. Redazione e aggiornamento della documentazione operativa interna. Titolo di studio Laurea triennale o magistrale in Marketing, Economia, Digital Management, Ingegneria Gestionale o discipline affini. Esperienza 2–3 anni di esperienza in ruoli e-commerce operativi (E-commerce Specialist, E-catalog Specialist, E-commerce Operations Specialist, E-commerce Merchandiser o simili). Esperienza in contesti retail, FMCG, GDO o e-commerce con frequenti attività commerciali e promozionali. Competenze tecniche e informatiche Esperienza nella gestione di piattaforme e-commerce e cataloghi digitali. Conoscenza di sistemi CMS/back office e dei processi di gestione delle informazioni di prodotto. Utilizzo di strumenti di web analytics (Google Analytics 4) e capacità di reporting e interpretazione dei dati. Buona conoscenza delle dinamiche promozionali e commerciali del retail. Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Excel (formule, tabelle pivot, gestione e analisi di dataset complessi). Conoscenza di base delle logiche SEO applicate ai contenuti e ai cataloghi prodotto. Costituiscono titoli preferenziali Esperienza nel settore GDO o retail, in particolare in contesti omnicanale. Certificazioni n ambito Web Analytics, Digital Marketing o piattaforme e-commerce. Esperienza nella gestione di cataloghi digitali con un elevato numero di referenze. Soft skills Forte orientamento ai risultati e approccio data-driven. Attenzione al prodotto e sensibilità verso i trend di consumo. Ottime capacità organizzative e abilità nel gestire contemporaneamente più attività e priorità. Problem solving e approccio pragmatico. Flessibilità e proattività in un contesto in forte crescita. Capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare con interlocutori appartenenti a diverse funzioni aziendali. Cosa offriamo Contratto a tempo indeterminato. CCNL Commercio (Confcommercio). Per questa posizione è prevista una retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) compresa tra € 28.000 e € 32.000. La proposta economica sarà commisurata all’esperienza, alle competenze e al percorso professionale, nel rispetto dell’inquadramento previsto per il ruolo. Accesso a sconti riservati ai dipendenti. Ambiente di lavoro dinamico, inclusivo e collaborativo, dove le idee vengono valorizzate. La ricerca è rivolta a tutte le persone, senza distinzione di genere, età, nazionalità, origine, orientamento, disabilità o altre caratteristiche tutelate dalla normativa vigente. L'IT Manager è responsabile della gestione e sviluppo dei sistemi informativi aziendali, con un focus prioritario sul sistema ERP SAP, del coordinamento e supervisione dell'infrastruttura tecnologica aziendale e della promozione di soluzioni di trasformazione digitale per il miglioramento continuo. La figura opera nel rispetto delle linee guida rilasciate dalla Direzione e delle esigenze del business per il Gruppo Polti. Gestione SAP e Applicazioni Aziendali Garantire il corretto funzionamento del sistema SAP e delle applicazioni aziendali integrate. Raccogliere e analizzare le esigenze delle diverse funzioni aziendali, traducendole in requisiti funzionali e tecnici. Coordinare e gestire le attività operative, evolutive e correttive di miglioramento continuo relative a SAP anche in collaborazione con il fornitore esterno. Supportare gli utenti chiave (Key User) nelle attività di test, formazione e gestione delle anomalie. Assicurare la corretta integrazione tra SAP e gli altri sistemi aziendali. Guidare lo sviluppo, l’implementazione e l’evoluzione delle soluzioni di Business Intelligence (Power BI), assicurando la disponibilità di analisi e dashboard a supporto delle decisioni. Infrastruttura IT, Cybersecurity e Compliance Pianificare, coordinare e supervisionare l’attività della struttura dipendente, al fine di garantire la soddisfazione degli utenti e la sicurezza dei sistemi informativi e dei dati aziendali, assicurando la compliance normativa (es. GDPR) e la gestione dei rischi (NIS2). Project Management Collaborare con i responsabili delle diverse funzioni aziendali per raccogliere esigenze e sviluppare soluzioni tecnologiche adeguate ed in linea con gli obiettivi di business. Promuovere iniziative di innovazione e digital transformation, identificando opportunità di ottimizzazione dei processi aziendali. Gestione Fornitori e Budget Selezionare, negoziare e gestire i rapporti con fornitori e partner tecnologici. Monitorare i livelli di servizio (SLA) e la qualità delle prestazioni fornite. Elaborare e controllare il budget IT ottimizzando costi e investimenti. Supporto agli Utenti Supervisione del servizio di help desk e supporto tecnico. Assicurare la risoluzione tempestiva delle problematiche informatiche. Promuovere ed assicurare lo sviluppo di una cultura informatica in azienda, garantendo la formazione e l’informazione dell’utenza. REQUISITI TECNICI : Esperienza pregressa nel ruolo di 10-15 anni; Preferibile laurea in Informatica, Data Science o discipline affini; Buona conoscenza dei principali processi aziendali e dei moduli SAP (ambito Finance, Sales, Controlling, Purchasing, Production, Warehouse Management); Conoscenza del linguaggio di programmazione ABAP; Esperienza nella gestione delle integrazioni tra SAP e altri applicativi (EDI, API, oDATA); Conoscenza di Business Intelligence Power BI; Esperienza nella raccolta e definizione dei requisiti di business, coordinamento dei test e gestione del change management; Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata; Preferibile interesse per le tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale, propensione al costante aggiornamento in materia, anche attraverso percorsi formativi, e capacità di valutarne le applicazioni a supporto dei processi aziendali. COMPETENZE TRASVERSALI: Forte orientamento al business e comprensione dei processi aziendali; Capacità di interfacciarsi con consulenti applicativi e fornitori esterni e coordinare attività trasversali tra funzioni aziendali e partner tecnologici; Attitudine alla mediazione e alla gestione delle priorità in contesti in continua evoluzione; Capacità di comunicazione e ascolto, capacità analitiche, disponibilità, orientamento al cliente. Si propone un’assunzione a tempo indeterminato e retribuzione proporzionata in relazione al profilo. RANGE RAL: 60-70 K€ L'offerta è rivolta a candidati ambosessi (art. 27 D.Lgs. 198/2006). Diesen Job melden Company Description MF Group is a subsidiary of Riverty and part of the Bertelsmann Group. Around 120 employees work across two locations in Switzerland to make invoice-based purchasing with flexible installment payments even simpler and safer for Swiss retailers. As a leading Swiss provider, we are a key partner for the retail sector, combining credit checks, fraud prevention, invoicing, and pre-financing into a comprehensive end‑to‑end solution. In addition to our straightforward invoice payment solutions—both online and in‑store—we offer private customers flexible cash loans. We also issue a variety of payment cards. Our strength lies in managing complex projects where multiple sales channels and payment methods interact seamlessly. We work with nearly all major brick‑and‑mortar and online retailers in Switzerland, actively shaping the future of payments. Job Description We are looking for a Product Operations Expert (m/f/d) Permanent, full-time | Chiasso | Flexible working conditions available Job Responsibilities As a Product Operations Expert , you will help ensure a smooth merchant journey and effective operations across MF Group’s payment solutions. Working closely with Product, Account Management, Risk Management, Sales and Engineering, you will connect merchant needs with technical execution and contribute to improving integration quality, operational efficiency and customer experience. In Particular, You Will Manage merchant integrations end to end. Own and coordinate integrations from initial assessment to go-live, guiding merchants and integration partners towards scalable setups that meet their needs. This includes direct and PSP integrations, new feature adoption and PSP changes. Monitor performance and investigate issues. Analyze operational and integration performance across the merchant lifecycle, detect issues and performance degradation, conduct initial root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders. Improve operational processes. Identify recurring inefficiencies and drive improvements to processes, tools and best practices for merchant onboarding, integration and lifecycle management. Build reusable documentation and knowledge. Maintain structured product documentation and knowledge repositories covering merchant integrations, configurations and operational cases, making insights accessible and reusable. Provide insights for product improvements and prioritization. Translate merchant performance data, operational insights and recurring integration patterns into structured input to support product improvements and prioritization. Qualifications Qualifications What Will Help You To Succeed In The Role Several years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Business Analysis, Operational Excellence or similar roles, with hands-on experience managing end-to-end processes, cross-functional stakeholders and operational or technical challenges. Strong understanding of business and technical processes, with the ability to translate business and merchant needs into scalable operational and technical solutions. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across Product, Business, Risk, Sales and Engineering and bring structure and clarity to complex topics. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using KPIs and operational metrics to identify issues, investigate root causes and drive continuous improvement. Proficiency in German and English is required; French or Italian would be an advantage. How To Stand Out Experience within Payments, FinTech, Lending or BNPL, with knowledge of PSPs and merchant integration models. Knowledge of the Swiss payments, financial services or merchant ecosystem. Experience with data, automation and productivity tools such as Power BI, SQL, Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Zendesk or AI-enabled solutions. Additional Information Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data: Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG. The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here. Le Principali Attività Saranno Organizzazione e gestione della partecipazione a fiere ed eventi di settore, incluse le attività di comunicazione correlate. Aggiornamento periodico e sviluppo di nuovi contenuti per i siti web aziendali. Gestione dei canali social media aziendali. Supporto alle attività di comunicazione relative al lancio di nuovi prodotti, sia verso il mercato che all'interno dell'organizzazione. Realizzazione e aggiornamento di cataloghi prodotto e materiale promozionale destinato alla rete vendita e ai clienti. Gestione dei rapporti con stampa, scuole, istituzioni locali e altri stakeholder esterni. Preparazione di presentazioni commerciali e strumenti di marketing a supporto delle attività di vendita. Organizzazione di eventi interni e iniziative di engagement aziendale. Supporto nelle attività di analisi di mercato e monitoraggio dei competitor. Precisione, affidabilità, flessibilità e capacità di lavorare in team completano il profilo, insieme a buone doti relazionali e comunicative. About Oerlikon Oerlikon is a global leader in material science engineering. Through the right combination of surface technologies, advanced materials, coating equipment, engineered components and advanced manufacturing, we help customers improve the performance, efficiency, durability and sustainability of their products and processes. Our technologies are often invisible to the end user, but mission-critical to the industries that power modern life: aerospace, energy, semiconductors, medical, luxury, tooling, automotive and general industries. Headquartered in Pfaeffikon, Switzerland, Oerlikon operates in 38 countries with a global workforce of around 10,000 people. In 2025, Oerlikon achieved sales of CHF 1.6 billion. We offer a wide variety of job profiles in a dynamic, supportive environment where people are empowered to grow and reach their full potential - guided by our core values of integrity, team spirit, excellence and innovation. About Oerlikon Luxury Oerlikon Luxury specializes in producing accessories for the high-end fashion industry. It comprises two brands: Oerlikon Riri, which produces branded Riri and Cobrax zippers and buttons respectively; and Oerlikon Fineparts, which offers metal components, fashion jewellery and surface treatments. Oerlikon Luxury is headquartered in Mendrisio, Switzerland, counts 1100 employees at 11 sites located in Italy, Switzerland, France and Portugal as well as sales offices in New York, Paris and Shanghai. Consulente clienti
KPT Versicherungen AG
Sede: Lugano e home office, Ticino, Svizzera
Join KPT, one of Switzerland's top health insurers. Enjoy a supportive work environment and flexible hours! Tasks Provide tailored advice to clients for optimal insurance coverage. Assist clients with inquiries through inbound and outbound processes. Identify client needs and offer customized product solutions. Skills Completed basic education with experience in health insurance preferred. Strong customer service orientation and communication skills. Sales experience is a plus; fluency in Italian required. La KPT è tra le dieci maggiori assicurazioni sanitarie in Svizzera. La soddisfazione dei nostri clienti è il nostro successo. I nostri consulenti clienti sono il primo interlocutore per i nostri assicurati: conoscono ogni dettaglio dei nostri innovativi prodotti, illustrano le prestazioni in modo comprensibile e trovano la soluzione migliore per ogni richiesta. Ti appassiona aiutare i clienti, spiegare il mondo della cassa malati e conquistarli con le tue conoscenze? Consulente clienti Cosa ti aspetta Offri consulenza agli assicurati, individui le lacune e li assisti nei processi inbound e outbound per ottenere una copertura ottimale, sia per telefono che per iscritto. Con l'impegno che metti in campo ogni giorno contribuisci alla soddisfazione completa dei nostri clienti. Con il tuo entusiasmo, trasmetti ai nuovi clienti l'interesse per i nostri prodotti. Richieste complesse? Ottieni le informazioni giuste dai nostri reparti specializzati. Grazie al tuo talento nella vendita, sei in grado di individuare le esigenze dei clienti e offrire soluzioni su misura dal nostro portafoglio prodotti. Cosa ci aspettiamo da te una formazione di base conclusa con prime esperienze lavorative nel settore dell'assicurazione sanitaria o in un contact center interesse per la vendita - idealmente anche esperienza in questo campo formazione come intermediario/a assicurativo/a AFA o disponibilità a seguirla quanto prima un forte orientamento al cliente e al servizio perfetta conoscenza scritta e orale dell'italiano – ogni altra lingua è un grande vantaggio I tuoi benefit Lavoro e vacanze Settimana di 40 ore lavorative e orari di lavoro flessibili Possibilità di lavoro da casa 2- 5 giorni di ferie, a partire dai 50 anni di età 30 giorni 24 e 31 dicembre giorni festivi retribuiti Pausa retribuita di 15 minuti sia al mattino che al pomeriggio Uffici moderni in posizione centrale presso la stazione di Lugano Mobilità Rail Coupon di CHF 300.– per un abbonamento annuale, di percorso o generale (AG) o metà-prezzo PLUS CHF 2'200.– Reka-Pay all'anno con 20% di sconto Abbonamento metà-prezzo annuale per i viaggi di lavoro Congedo di maternità e paternità, famiglia Pagamento dello stipendio al 100% per un periodo di 16 settimane in caso di maternità Pagamento dello stipendio al 100% per un periodo di 4 settimane in caso di paternità Assegno matrimoniale Malattia, infortunio, previdenza per la vecchiaia Pagamento dello stipendio al 100% in caso di malattia e infortunio per un periodo di 2 anni 50% del premio dell'assicurazione per l'indennità giornaliera per malattia e del 100% dell'assicurazione contro gli infortuni non professionali Fondazione di previdenza a favore del personale KPT: contributo del 60% da parte del datore di lavoro e scelta tra 2 varianti Formazione continua Partecipazione ai costi dei corsi di formazione continua Offerta di formazione e aggiornamento esterna e interna diversificata E inoltre... Learning & Development Specialist
EFG Bank AG
Sede: Lugano, Ticino, Svizzera
Join EFG International as a Learning & Development Specialist! Experience a dynamic environment and great opportunities. Tasks Manage apprenticeships end-to-end, from recruitment to training. Measure programme effectiveness through reports and feedback surveys. Coordinate global learning initiatives and provide technical support. Skills University degree in HR or related field; 5+ years experience. Fluency in English, French, and Italian; strong interpersonal skills. Proficient in MS Office; proactive with exceptional organizational skills. Learning & Development Specialist Job Description Our Company EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice. EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation. Our Purpose and Mission Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future. We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value. Job Description As a key member of the Learning & Development team, the Learning & Development Specialist will contribute to the organisation and coordination of selected learning initiatives and manage EFG’s apprenticeship programmes end to end, ensuring a best-in-class experience. The Learning & Development Specialist will collaborate with all HR functional areas and become a key point of contact within the organisation for their assigned activities. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to work in an international, fast-paced and client-oriented HR team within a global private banking group. Main responsibilities Manage end-to-end the apprentices programme (recruitment, onboarding, rotations, learning sessions etc) in Switzerland, partnering with line managers and HR Business Partners/local HR. Prepare reports and feedback surveys to measure programme effectiveness; analyse insights to assess impact and identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate selected global learning initiatives, supporting design, rollout, communications and logistics. Provide expert technical support for training initiatives, empowering employees to make the most of the company’s learning tools and systems. The Learning & Development Specialist will have a dual reporting line to the Head of Talent Development and the Head of Learning. The role collaborates with HRBPs, local HR, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery and adherence to global frameworks. Skills and experience University degree, preferably in human resources, organizational development, economics, or a related field 5+ of relevant experience within structured HR departments of international companies Strong commitment to people development and delivering outstanding customer service Demonstrated interest in learning technologies; experience with learning design tools (e.g. Articulate) preferred Fluency in English, French, and Italian International mindset and experience working in multicultural environments Proactive, positive attitude with energy and intellectual curiosity Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills; proven ability to work with diverse stakeholders across functions and countries Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly and effectively structure key messages Exceptional organizational skills; able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver in a dynamic and demanding environment Proficiency in MS Office programs Our Values Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit. Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

A volte, purtroppo, le risposte sono filtrate come Spam: ricordati di controllare la cartella. Your Responsibilities Guidi e definisci la social strategy in linea con gli obiettivi di brand e la strategia di comunicazione integrata. Supervisioni e orienti la content e channel strategy, garantendo la qualità della content creation e l'efficacia dell'analisi delle performance. Coordini, formi e gestisci operativamente il team dedicato, supportandone la crescita professionale. Sei l'escalation point e il consulente strategico/creativo di riferimento per i clienti sui progetti Social Media più complessi. Dirigi e validi la creazione di contenuti originali, inclusi post, immagini, video e stories. Imposti i framework di misurazione, supervisionando l'analisi di KPI, insight e i risultati complessivi delle attività social. Conosci approfonditamente e applichi le logiche di content creation, branded content, influencer marketing. Supervisioni lo sviluppo delle attività di influencer marketing, dall'ideazione strategica all'implementazione. Costruisci e presenti documenti strategici sull'andamento delle attività, intercettando e guidando opportunità di crescita e upselling. Coordini un team esteso e multidisciplinare composto da community manager, copywriter e art director. Guidi il team nell'individuare insight, trend social e spunti di comunicazione rilevanti. Promuovi e sperimenti l'innovazione della comunicazione social anche attraverso l'integrazione di processi di AI generativa. Who You Are Almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo. Comprovata capacità di leadership, mentoring e gestione di team. Spiccate capacità analitiche e ottime doti di sintesi per presentazioni direzionali. Capacità di individuare bisogni non presidiati e nuove opportunità di business e comunicazione. Forte interesse per i trend digitali, social e tecnologici. Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata. Solida esperienza nella supervisione, creazione e gestione di contenuti per diverse piattaforme social. Competenza nell'utilizzo di tool come Canva, Photoshop e CapCut per supportare e indirizzare il lavoro operativo del team. Familiarità avanzata con tool di Social Media Management come Rival IQ ed Emplify. Ottima conoscenza ed esperienza manageriale su Meta Business Manager e Google Suite. Approccio strategico e creativo unito a una solida capacità di storytelling per i brand. Attitudine alla leadership, al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con figure multidisciplinari. Entusiasmo, curiosità e propensione a guidare l'innovazione e sperimentare continuamente. Precisione, attenzione ai dettagli, rispetto delle scadenze e spiccato problem solving. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. What We Offer Per questo ruolo prevediamo un package tra €32.000 e €43.000, costruito sulla base di esperienza, seniority e competenze. Buoni pasto Satispay. Supporto psicologico e nutrizionale con Serenis. Pacchetto Welfare trasversale. Postazione e attrezzatura Apple. Formazione ed eventi offerti da Caffeina. Coffee & water 24/7. A sustainable, profitable and enjoyable future for dairy farmers by combining robotization, engineering and farmer knowledge. We believe in that. That started 75 years ago with a dream of two brothers in Maassluis (The Netherlands). Since then, we have been an innovative leader in automated systems for dairy farmers around the world. With 2.300 specialized professionals, we are constantly working on new agricultural revolutions. We do this from our Campus in Maassluis, but also from other international offices. Together we have the goal: to make dairy farming interesting for the next generation . Job Description About the Role We are looking for a commercially driven and strategic Manager Proposition – Manure to lead the growth and performance of our Manure portfolio across Southeast Europe & Türkiye. This is a key leadership role within the Cluster Management Team . You will report functionally to the Head of Commerce and locally to the Cluster Manager and you will be responsible for ensuring sustainable growth, strong market adoption, and high-performing installed systems on farms. You will act as the vital link between Lely International, Cluster SEET, and our Lely Centers . Your main activities Lead and develop a winning team, driving high performance, ownership and a collaborative culture. Drive commercial performance, building a healthy pipeline, identifying growth opportunities and delivering sustainable business results. Lead the Manure Proposition, defining priorities and translating regional strategy into clear commercial actions across the markets. Enable and develop the distribution network, strengthening the commercial and operational capabilities of our Lely Centers in all relevant areas. Own end-to-end execution, ensuring alignment between sales growth, installation capacity and service capability to deliver a strong customer experience from sales through installation and after-sales service. The role is based in Colturano (MI), and it requires willingness to travel within Italy, to the HQ in Maassluis (NL) and to the countries covered by our Cluster. Qualifications What You Bring You have successfully completed university studies You speak, write and present in English and Italian fluently You have experience in leading and influencing multi-disciplinary teams You are a confident communicator, comfortable handling challenging conversations when needed You bring a strong commercial mindset and a proven ability to turn market opportunities into business results while maintaining a strong customer focus You have a solid business management background, ideally gained in a B2B environment involving dealers, distributors, franchises, machinery, technology or complex solutions Experience in agriculture, automation, or a related industry is an advantage, but not essential. Additional Information Our team An international and cross-functional team, offering plenty of opportunities to learn, exchange perspectives and work across markets. A positive and proactive environment, where we work with a common purpose and towards clear goals. Assertive and attentive communicators who believe in the power of kind and constructive communication. Efficient and well-organized, making good use of time, resources and expertise. Data-driven in our approach, using facts and insights to support decisions and improve performance. A team where ownership and collaboration go hand in hand, and where people are encouraged to contribute beyond the boundaries of their individual role Our offer A Certified Great Place To Work® An open work environment with flexible working hours A conducive environment that encourages personal development and growth Our Lely Academy with a variety of training programs The position will be aligned with a predefined salary band, which will be disclosed to the candidate during the recruitment process. Segnala offerta di lavoro EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS | Introduction Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization. Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive-networks.com. At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES | About the role The Senior Services Sales Manager is a high-impact commercial role responsible for driving growth across Exclusive Networks' services portfolio, including professional services, support, training, and managed services. This role acts as the engine for services growth-creating demand, building pipeline, and collaborating with sales, technical, marketing, vendors, and reseller partners. You will shape services execution in the region while supporting sales teams to position services as a key part of every customer engagement. Key Responsibilities Services Revenue Growth Generate, develop, and close services opportunities across all service lines. Increase service attach rates to product and solution sales. Identify, qualify, and manage high-value opportunities with vendors, partners, and named accounts. Execute local account development plans in partnership with distribution sales teams. Own and deliver against the regional services sale's targets and gross profit goals. Demand Generation & Market Development Drive partner engagement through workshops, joint customer meetings, and value-based selling. Clearly articulate the Exclusive Networks services proposition to partners, vendors, and customers. Support marketing campaigns, events, and initiatives to stimulate demand. Identify additional service offerings with vendors to grow services utilisation. Collaboration & Execution Work Closely With Multiple Stakeholders To Drive Services Success Sales Account Managers & Sales Leadership Pre-sales and Technical Services teams Vendor management teams Marketing teams Strategic reseller partners Regional Technical Services Directors/Managers & Regional Services Leadership Enablement Team - both internal and channel facing Pipeline Management & Forecasting Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and opportunity tracking. Conduct progression reviews, conversion analysis, and win/loss reporting. Provide regular updates and insight to Regional Services Leads. Additional Responsibilities Build strong relationships across sales, solutions, operations, and go-to-market teams. Provide ongoing enablement, training and support to local sales teams to promote a services-first mindset. Engage with the service advisory board and services sales desk. Develop clear proposals, service quotations, and customer presentations. Understand external market trends and identify opportunities for growth. Provide regional support for GSI (Global System Integrator) accounts where required. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE | About you The Ideal Senior Services Sales Manager 5+ years' experience in IT, cybersecurity, or services business development. Proven success selling professional services, support, training, or managed services. Experience working within reseller, channel, vendor, or distribution ecosystems. Demonstrable ability to build strong customer partnerships, including at executive level. Skills & Competencies Strong commercial acumen and understanding of services margin models. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to articulate services as business outcomes. Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence without authority. Analytical, inquisitive, and data-driven approach to pipeline management. Growth mindset with an entrepreneurial approach to problem-solving. Ability to thrive in challenging and changing environments. Willingness to travel as required. Performance Metrics Success In This Role Is Measured By Services revenue bookings and gross profit delivery Pipeline generation and progression Services attach rate to product sales Partner engagement and enablement effectiveness Accuracy of forecasting and pipeline management Growth of strategic accounts and services utilisation WHO ARE EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS? | Why work for us We are people focused and strongly believe that talent empowers us to continue our dynasty of disruption and growth in the future. Our Mission is to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital world for all people and organizations. Visit our website www.exclusive-networks.com. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to the recruitment and hiring of individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences, as we believe this strengthens our ability to develop superior solutions, make informed decisions, and better serve our valued customers. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability status, or any similar characteristic. La responsabilità Il/La Direttore Generale avrà la responsabilità di presidiare e coordinare il funzionamento complessivo della struttura aziendale, favorendo l'integrazione tra le diverse funzioni e assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi economici, organizzativi e gestionali. In particolare, si occuperà di: Presidiare la gestione e l'organizzazione degli uffici , assicurando efficacia, coordinamento e corretta gestione dei processi. Affiancare il CEO nella definizione del budget aziendale , contribuendo alla pianificazione economica e finanziaria e al monitoraggio degli scostamenti. Definire e monitorare, in collaborazione con il CEO, i principali KPI aziendali , trasformando i dati di gestione in indicazioni e azioni concrete. Coordinare il responsabile amministrativo nella predisposizione del bilancio , interfacciandosi con consulenti e professionisti esterni. Gestire e coordinare i rapporti con le prime linee manageriali (HR, Logistica e Operation, Amministrazione e Commerciale) e i consulenti aziendali , rappresentando il principale punto di riferimento interno sulle diverse tematiche specialistiche. Presidiare la governance del personale , assicurando coerenza tra struttura organizzativa, fabbisogni, costi e obiettivi aziendali. Mantenendo, la guida operativa e strategica alle varie funzioni; Gestire i rapporti con revisori, Collegio Sindacale e altri organi di controllo , garantendo la corretta gestione delle informazioni e degli adempimenti. Coordinare le attività preparatorie e organizzative relative al Consiglio di amministrazione , assicurando la predisposizione della documentazione e delle informazioni necessarie. Garantire un costante reporting al CEO sull'andamento economico, organizzativo e gestionale della società. Individuare opportunità di efficientamento e miglioramento dei processi , contribuendo all'evoluzione dell'organizzazione. Supportare il CEO nei principali progetti di sviluppo e trasformazione aziendale , assicurandone il presidio organizzativo ed economico. Requirements Cerchiamo un/una manager con esperienza consolidata in aziende di servizi , preferibilmente caratterizzate da una significativa componente di capitale umano e da una struttura organizzativa articolata. È richiesta una conoscenza concreta di: gestione e organizzazione di strutture aziendali; amministrazione e contabilità; predisposizione, gestione e lettura del bilancio; pianificazione e gestione del budget; monitoraggio di KPI economici e gestionali; gestione di consulenti e professionisti esterni; rapporti con revisori e organi di controllo; gestione delle attività connesse al CDA e alla governance societaria; processi di gestione e governance del personale. Esperienza di servizi labour intensive Completano il profilo: Leadership e autorevolezza. Forte capacità organizzativa e di coordinamento. Solida conoscenza dei processi amministrativi, contabili ed economici. Capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Orientamento al risultato e alla sostenibilità economica. Approccio pragmatico e capacità di problem solving. Ottime capacità relazionali e di comunicazione. Capacità di gestire interlocutori a diversi livelli, interni ed esterni. Riservatezza, affidabilità e senso di responsabilità. Capacità di interfacciarsi efficacemente con il CEO, consulenti, revisori e organi societari. Visione d'insieme unita alla capacità di tradurre gli indirizzi strategici in budget, KPI e azioni concrete. Descrizione azienda FuturEnergy è una realtà specializzata nello sviluppo di soluzioni di forniture energetiche su misura per Piccole e Medie Imprese e clienti residenziali. Non proponiamo offerte standard: lavoriamo con un approccio consulenziale per costruire soluzioni personalizzate che rispondano davvero alle esigenze dei clienti, combinando analisi dei consumi, controllo dei costi, fotovoltaico, efficienza energetica e smart building. Siamo un'azienda in continua crescita, costruita su competenza, innovazione e valorizzazione delle persone. Crediamo che i risultati nascano dal talento, dalla determinazione e dalla possibilità di lavorare in un contesto che riconosce davvero il valore di chi contribuisce alla crescita dell'azienda. Posizione Il prossimo passo della tua carriera? Guidare la crescita di un territorio. FuturEnergy ricerca un/una Area Manager a cui affidare il coordinamento e lo sviluppo della propria rete commerciale sul territorio. Cerchiamo un professionista capace di valorizzare le persone, individuare nuove opportunità di business e contribuire attivamente al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali. Il ruolo prevede una collaborazione diretta con la Direzione Commerciale , con la possibilità di partecipare alle strategie di crescita dell'area assegnata. Il progetto che intendiamo condividere Avrai la responsabilità di sviluppare e consolidare la presenza commerciale di FuturEnergy sul territorio, occupandoti di: Sviluppo della rete: ricerca, selezione e inserimento di nuovi consulenti commerciali; Coordinamento del team: gestione e valorizzazione delle risorse della rete vendita; Formazione: accompagnamento dei consulenti nel percorso di crescita attraverso la nostra Academy; Raggiungimento degli obiettivi: monitoraggio delle attività e supporto al team per il conseguimento dei risultati; Concrete opportunità di crescita e sviluppo: individuazione di nuove opportunità commerciali e strategie di sviluppo. Requisiti Il profilo che stiamo cercando Ci rivolgiamo a professionisti con una forte attitudine alla leadership, capacità di pianificazione e visione strategica. Cosa Cerchiamo etica professionale e ambizione; esperienza nel coordinamento e nella crescita di reti commerciali; capacità di lavorare in autonomia e organizzare le attività; conoscenza del settore energetico o di mercati affini, considerata un plus ma non indispensabile. Benefit Programma di riconoscimenti e premi Viaggi premio / Incentivi aziendali Altre informazioni Una struttura commerciale a supporto dei tuoi risultati Entrare in FuturEnergy significa poter contare su strumenti, condizioni e opportunità pensati per sostenere concretamente lo sviluppo della tua area. Cosa Offriamo mandato diretto; trattamento economico con fisso, variabile e incentivi; possibilità di auto aziendale; offerte commerciali profilate e competitive per l'intero portafoglio potenziale business (micro PMI e industry); possibilità di proporre offerte personalizzate; procedure di analisi creditizia dirette e snelle; possibilità di conclusione contratto da remoto con firma OTP; strumenti di lead generation e sistemi di referral; opportunità concrete di crescita in ambito manageriale. Costruiamo collaborazioni solide e durature , valorizzando autonomia, competenze e risultati. Diventa essere protagonista dello sviluppo della nostra rete commerciale? Invia la tua candidatura e cresci con FuturEnergy. Segnala offerta di lavoro Compass Group Italia ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Compass Group Italia. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 40.000,00 €/yr - 45.000,00 €/anno Compass Group Italia , leader nei servizi di ristorazione collettiva e multiservizi, cerca un/una Marketing & Communication Specialist da inserire nella Direzione Commerciale presso gli uffici di Milano . La persona selezionata si occuperà di definire, sviluppare e realizzare le strategie di marketing e comunicazione, online e offline, per le diverse linee di business del Gruppo. Gli obiettivi principali sono rafforzare il brand corporate, supportare l'acquisizione di nuovi clienti B2B nel settore pubblico e privato e migliorare l'esperienza del consumatore finale. Attività principali Ristorazione aziendale Ideare campagne di comunicazione nei ristoranti aziendali per promuovere stili di vita sani, menu stagionali e settimane a tema. Realizzare presentazioni, brochure e case history a supporto del team commerciale. Ristorazione scolastica, sanitaria e istituzionale Gestire la comunicazione verso Comuni, scuole, ospedali e famiglie su temi come sostenibilità, filiera corta, allergeni e tracciabilità. Sviluppare progetti di educazione alimentare e collaborare con l'ufficio gare per la parte di comunicazione richiesta dai bandi. Motorsport e grandi eventi Curare branding e comunicazione visiva per catering VIP, aree hospitality e track-side. Ottimizzare segnaletica e menu board dei punti di ristoro temporanei, favorendo up-selling e cross-selling. Coordinare le attività di co-marketing con sponsor, brand partner e team. Sport & Leisure Sviluppare attivazioni di marketing in stadi e arene nei giorni di evento, ad esempio promozioni pre-partita e pacchetti VIP. Promuovere i punti di ristoro in parchi tematici, musei e centri sportivi, adattando l'offerta ai diversi target. Attività trasversali Gestire il sito web e i canali social: LinkedIn per il posizionamento B2B, Instagram e Facebook per eventi e motorsport. Coordinare la produzione di materiali cartacei e digitali (menu board, totem, divise) nel rispetto della brand identity. Redigere comunicati stampa su nuove aperture, partnership e traguardi di sostenibilità. Coordinare agenzie e fornitori esterni e interfacciarsi con i referenti internazionali del Gruppo. Monitorare i trend del food service e i risultati delle attività. Requisiti Laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Economia o discipline affini. Tra i 6 e gli 8 anni di esperienza nel marketing e nella comunicazione, preferibilmente nel food service/Horeca, nell'hospitality o negli eventi sportivi e di intrattenimento. Esperienza nella gestione di sponsorship, partnership ed eventi. Buona conoscenza di social media, CMS (es. WordPress), Google Analytics ed email marketing. Uso autonomo di Canva o Adobe Creative Suite e ottime doti di scrittura, sia creativa sia istituzionale. Inglese fluente. Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office, in particolare PowerPoint ed Excel. Flessibilità nel passare dal rigore del settore pubblico al ritmo dei grandi eventi. Ottime capacità organizzative, di gestire più progetti in parallelo e di lavorare sotto pressione. Cosa offriamo RAL tra 40.000 e 45.000 euro , commisurata all'esperienza. Inserimento in una realtà internazionale solida e strutturata. Un ruolo trasversale e molto visibile, con progetti che vanno dal B2B istituzionale al motorsport. Ambiente dinamico e collaborativo, attento alla crescita delle persone. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About JD Group Founded in 1981 and listed on the FTSE100, JD Group is a leading global multichannel retailer in sports fashion, outdoors, and gyms. Driven by innovation, excellence, and a people-first culture, our vision is to become the world’s most trusted and dynamic omni-channel retailer. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of the industry. This is JD Sports As our flagship brand, JD Sports is the industry leader in urban style, seamlessly combining physical and digital retail to give a compelling consumer proposition. We offer an elevated shopping experience, blending globally recognized brands like Nike and Adidas with strong, exclusive private labels. We are a fast-paced, fearless, and ambitious team—are you in? Role Overview The Social Media Executive is responsible for executing strategic growth, optimization, and daily management of JD’s local social media channels. This role demands a creative, data-driven, and highly digitally savvy professional capable of translating global brand directives into high-impact local social media campaigns that enhance brand visibility, drive audience engagement, and foster a loyal online community. The Social Media Executive will own the social media content calendar, coordinate both organic and paid social executions, and deliver structured weekly KPI performance reports. Key Responsibilities Execute and scale the development strategies for both organic and paid social media channels (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) to continuously increase follower acquisition, engagement rates, and referral traffic. Ensure regular content is pushed out across social media channels. Design, map, and publish consistent, trend-driven content streams, ensuring that all local social media platforms are visually premium and aligned with JD's voice. Work on developing integrated strategies that ensure social is always in the heart of what we do. Work with the Commercial and Retail team to ensure all relevant products are being promoted and showcased in the best way possible. Work with brands and third parties on promoting campaigns and competitions. Contribute to development of strategies and campaign ideas that will help improve follower numbers and interaction figures across all channels. Analyze social media performance and KPI results to define market trends, customer behavior and industry best practice. Skills & Experience Required High level verbal and written English. 2+ years of experience in a similar role. Degree in Marketing, Communication, or similars. What We Offer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a workplace where every colleague is valued, respected, and empowered. We celebrate the diversity of our teams and strive to ensure that all colleagues regardless of background, identity, or lived experience can thrive and contribute meaningfully. As a part of our successful and continually evolving company, you’ll be encouraged to embrace and uphold our strategic priorities: putting people first, at the forefront of digital innovation, staying deeply attuned to our customers, and pursuing operational excellence. We are always exploring new avenues for growth, and we welcome individuals who are passionate about making a positive impact every day. Please include in your CV your consent to the processing of your personal data in accordance with EU Regulation No. 679/2016 and current Italian legislation. The large number of applications our company receives requires careful consideration. If you do not hear from us within the first two weeks of applying, please feel free to explore other opportunities or keep an eye on our Career Page and follow our LinkedIn page to stay updated on all vacancies. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Who We Are Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is a global management consulting ﬁrm and leading advisor on business strategy, with more than 90 oﬃces in 50 countries. We partner with clients from the private, public and not-for-profit sectors in all regions to identify their highest-value opportunities, address their most critical challenges, and transform their enterprises. Our customized approach combines deep insight into the dynamics of companies and markets with close collaboration at all levels of the client organization. This ensures that our clients achieve sustainable competitive advantage, build more capable organizations, and secure lasting results. Practice Area BCG’s Tech and Digital practice area focuses on helping clients deliver competitive advantage and business superior performance through the use of data, technology and digital. Tech and Digital is the fastest growing practice at BCG and at the heart of the strategic impact we have with our clients. Our consultants and experts globally work across all industries and provide deep experience and expertise across a number of topics including Digital Transformation, Data & Digital Platforms, AI at Scale, Agile, Cybersecurity and Digitizing the Tech Function. Our Tech and Digital offer encompasses tech experts across BCG and Platinion, providing seamless multidisciplinary solutions to our clients. What You'll Do As a Consultant in BCG’s Tech & Digital Advantage practice, you will work with clients to address complex business and technology challenges through ERP-enabled transformation. You will bring together business, process, data, and technology perspectives to help organizations modernize their enterprise platforms and deliver measurable value. You will take ownership of defined project modules, working closely with BCG colleagues and client teams to structure problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop practical recommendations. Your work will focus primarily on SAP S/4HANA transformations, from strategy and design through implementation planning and value delivery. Key Responsibilities Include Own defined workstreams within SAP S/4HANA and broader ERP transformation programs. Analyze business processes, technology landscapes, data, and operating-model requirements. Develop transformation roadmaps, business cases, target-state designs, and implementation plans. Translate complex business needs into practical, scalable, technology-enabled solutions. Build clear, client-ready analyses, presentations, and recommendations for senior audiences. Support client workshops, interviews, and working sessions across business and technology teams. Collaborate with multidisciplinary BCG teams to connect ERP, digital, data, and AI capabilities. Contribute expertise, insights, and reusable approaches to BCG’s Tech & Digital Advantage practice. What You'll Bring Digital technology is reshaping every industry, and ERP platforms sit at the center of that transformation. As a Consultant in BCG’s Tech & Digital Advantage practice, you will help leading organizations modernize their technology foundations, unlock value from enterprise data, and accelerate business transformation through SAP S/4HANA and broader ERP-enabled change. You will work with business and technology leaders to address complex strategic and operational challenges, combining technology expertise with business insight. As part of multidisciplinary teams, you will help shape and deliver end-to-end transformations that connect strategy, processes, operating models, data, and technology. You will work primarily with BCG teams and clients in Italy, collaborating with other Consultants, Project Leaders, Principals, and colleagues across the Tech & Digital Advantage practice. You will also work with teams across the wider EMC (East Mediterranean and Caspian) system and, where relevant, EMESA, bringing broader expertise and perspectives to client engagements. We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our practice. You would typically have: 5–8 years of experience in ERP programs or enterprise transformation. Hands-on experience as a Process Owner, Product Owner, or equivalent transformation lead roles. Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA-enabled business or comparable ERP solutions. Experience contributing to large-scale ERP implementations or enterprise transformation programs. Experience applying AI, generative AI, advanced analytics, or emerging technologies to improve enterprise processes and business performance. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business, or a related field. Outstanding academic achievement, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in Italian and English. Additional info Additional Info At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an essential role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. That's why we generally operate on a hybrid model, with office presence shaped by business needs, team norms, and local policies and practices. We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. Compensation Information Total compensation for this role includes base salary and a benefits package described below. Our Reward Philosophy is to take a holistic approach to offer a comprehensive package which includes market-competitive base salary and benefits that can support both physical and mental health. Our philosophy drives our actions and aims at being competitive, fair and easy for employees to understand. We are committed to ensuring that BCG is the best place for you to thrive and grow. The annual base salary for this role is at least EUR 87.000. Employees may also be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus. BCG offers a best-in-class benefits package designed to provide comprehensive care and meaningful support to you and your family. Benefits may vary based on role, contract type, and eligibility criteria. Our Benefits Include Health insurance: comprehensive medical coverage for employees with the option to extend coverage to eligible family members. Meal vouchers and corporate discounts: daily meal allowance and access to a range of partner discounts. Life / Accident / Disability Insurance for employees Employee Assistance Program (EAP): confidential psychological, legal, and financial support services. Well-being initiatives: programs supporting physical health, mental well-being, and family needs Flexible benefits/Welfare: an annual flexible benefits allowance that can be used for eligible services such as education, health, transport, and leisure activities Company car plan. Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. E-COMMERCE SPECIALIST Are you passionate about e-commerce, digital campaigns and turning insights into business growth? Do you enjoy building customer relationships and working across teams? And, above all, do you like beer and drinking responsibly? We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical talent to join our team. Read on — we could be looking for you! What You’ll Be Doing As E-commerce Specialist, you will support the development of Carlsberg Italy’s B2C sales channel, reporting to the E-commerce & Export Manager. You will help grow our Amazon retail business through promotional activities and advertising campaigns, and work to develop retailers’ online channels. From customer planning and commercial performance to digital activation and post-campaign evaluation, you will help grow our online market share. You will also explore new opportunities with On-Trade digital platforms and online-to-offline (O2O) players. Your activities will be focused on: Business Development & Customer Planning Grow the existing Amazon retail business, identify opportunities to increase our share, and implement the Off-Trade e-commerce plan to strengthen our online presence in grocery. Build joint business plans with assigned customers, covering assortment, pricing, promotions and visibility. Adapt Carlsberg marketing plans into effective customer presentations and maintain day-to-day relationships with buyers and key stakeholders. Scout new opportunities with On-Trade digital platforms and O2O players. Customer P&L & Promotions Own the P&L of assigned customers, monitoring volumes, net sales and GPAL. Manage trade terms and promotional investments with Business Controlling to maximise returns. Analyse and define customer pricing strategies, regularly reviewing their impact on volumes, net sales and margins. Build and negotiate national promotional plans for assigned customers and track return on investment (ROI). Digital Campaigns & Market Insights Plan annual digital campaign calendars with Marketing and Trade Marketing. Monitor live campaigns and fine-tune campaign settings to deliver the expected return on advertising spend (ROAS). Evaluate campaign results, identify what worked and translate learnings into more effective future activations. Monitor market trends and competitor activity at assigned customers, proposing appropriate actions. Forecasting, Operations & Reporting Deliver accurate, timely monthly customer forecasts to Demand Planning. Work with Customer Service, Credit and Logistics to support smooth order-to-cash processes and service levels. Organise top-to-top customer meetings with Sales Management and prepare and present quarterly business reviews. Collaborate with internal commercial and support functions, as well as customers’ buyers, category managers and media managers. What we’re looking for: You combine a commercial mindset with strong analytical skills and an interest in digital sales. You are comfortable turning sales and campaign data into practical actions, building customer relationships and collaborating across functions. Ability to track and analyse sales KPIs, traffic and conversions using tools such as Google Analytics. Understanding of User Experience (UX) and Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) to improve on-site search, product visibility, consideration and conversion. Understanding of SEO and SEM, including product-page content optimisation and paid advertising campaigns. Familiarity with digital promotional formats and set-up, and marketing automation solutions. Good negotiation skills and understanding of trade terms, pricing and customer P&L. Strong analytical and data-planning skills, with confidence working with sell-out data and category insights. Italian at C1 level and English at B2/C1 level, spoken and written. MSC in Economics or similar. What You Can Expect A strong and engaged team, locally and across borders, in an inclusive environment that encourages people to challenge the status quo, pursue excellence with passion and thrive. Workplace: Milan Type of contract: permanent, full time. Gross Annual Salary: 40.000 € Benefits: Ticket restaurant, smartworking. Our Growth Culture What if your own growth could spark something bigger — for your team, your community and the world around you? What if curiosity, courage and care weren’t just values on a poster, but the way we actually work together every day? This is the kind of culture we’re building. Explore our Growth Culture on the Carlsberg Group careers website. Interested? To send your CV, please apply through Carlsberg Italia careers page. We review applications continuously, and the vacancy may be filled before the deadline, so apply as early as possible. We look forward to your application! To comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), we only accept applications through our applicant system. Carlsberg Group: Brewing for a better today and tomorrow For us success has always been in the diverse mix of our people, our beers and our brands. At Carlsberg, we want to recruit and develop people with a global mindset, cultural understanding, and international experience to ensure that our organization stays agile, inclusive and prepared for future growth. Only by acknowledging and harvesting from different perspectives and experiences, will we gain competitive advantage and leverage the effect of diversity for business growth. Carlsberg aims to create equal access to opportunity regardless of social identity, and we encourage everyone to apply regardless of gender, nationality, race, religion or any other characteristics protected by law.
