Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours. This is a 21- month secondment/fixed term opportunity. The Change Readiness Lead is the senior change leader on the program responsible for defining and driving the program’s change strategy, readiness approach, governance, and delivery standards to ensure a consistent, high-quality, and business-focused change experience across functions and business units. Reporting directly to the Program Change Director, the Change Readiness Lead owns the quality, consistency, and rigour of functional change outputs, establishes and governs the Program readiness framework and criteria, standardises key capability interventions such as the Key User journey, and manages the day-to-day delivery, tracking, and governance of the integrated change plan. How You Will Contribute You will: Change Strategy & Approach: Define and own the Program Change Management Strategy, business engagement approach, and operating model — and establish the methodology, templates, and toolkits used by all Functional and BU Change Leads. Readiness Framework & Governance: Define go-live gate criteria and the readiness assessment approach; consolidate readiness inputs from all FCLs and BCLs into a Program-level view; chair readiness forums and report status to the Program Change Director. CIA Quality Assurance: Own the QA process for all Change Impact Assessments and key change deliverables — reviewing for rigour, completeness, and consistency, and providing structured feedback before materials are used in governance or shared with stakeholders. Key User Journey Standardisation: Define and standardise the end-to-end Key User Learning Journey across functions and BUs; set measurable go/no-go criteria for Key User readiness and monitor Program-wide completion and confidence. Change Plan Management: Own the Program-wide Change Plan, manage cross-workstream dependencies, run the change team's operating rhythm, and produce consolidated change status reports to the Program Change Director. Risk & Issue Management: Own the Program-level change risk and issues log — ensuring owners and mitigations are assigned and escalating systemic risks with root cause analysis and proposed interventions. Team Leadership: Directly lead, manage, and develop the Functional Change Lead team; hold BU Change Leads to Program standards through governance and QA; collaborate as a peer with the Training Lead and Communications Lead. Program Representation: Represent change and readiness at design authority, Program leadership forums, and steering committee; act as deputy to the Program Change Director when required. Capability Building: Build lasting organisational change capability — develop frameworks and standards that outlast the Program and leave the organisation better equipped to manage change independently. What You Will Bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: Experience: 8–10 years' progressive experience in change management or business transformation at senior leadership level, with a proven track record leading change on large-scale ERP, CRM, or comparable enterprise transformation Programs. Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated ability to design and own a Program-level change strategy — not just execute within one defined by others — and translate strategic objectives into an actionable, governed delivery plan. Leadership Presence: Confidence to lead, challenge, and align senior stakeholders at Program Director, C-suite, and steering committee level; proven people leadership of a change team. Quality & Rigour: Demonstrable experience quality-assuring change deliverables (CIAs, Personas, Change Action Plans) and coaching others to improve quality; able to define and defend a high standard. Readiness Governance: Experience defining and governing a Program readiness framework including assessment criteria, scoring methodology, and go-live gate standards across multiple functions or business units. Analytics & Reporting: Ability to consolidate data from multiple change workstreams into clear, governance-ready dashboards and status reports for senior leadership and steering committee audiences. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate change complexity into clear, authoritative, and audience-appropriate messaging. Tools & Systems: Proficiency in Program management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira) and collaboration platforms (SharePoint, Teams, Confluence). Handling complexity: Comfortable working in a matrixed environment across multiple functions and business units, managing ambiguity and competing priorities at Program pace. System implementation exposure: Familiarity with the specific platform being implemented (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Salesforce) and the change challenges it presents is highly preferred. More About This Role This is a 21- month secondment/fixed term opportunity. What you need to know about this position: This role sits at the heart of the Change Management function and is the senior change leadership role on the program, reporting directly to the Program Change Director. We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline — able to set direction and standards for the team, while also rolling up their sleeves to keep the Program on track at pace. The role provides direct leadership to Functional Change Leads and ensures consistent execution across BU Change Leads through governance, standards, and quality assurance. The candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, bringing order to complexity while maintaining strategic focus and team momentum. Education / Certifications: Bachelor's degree in business, Management, Organisational Psychology, or a related discipline. Practical working knowledge of a recognised change management methodology (Prosci ADKAR, APMG, Kotter, or equivalent). Prosci, APMG, or CCMP certification preferred. Program or project management qualification (MSP, PMP, PRINCE2) advantageous. Coaching qualification (ILM, ICF) advantageous given the people leadership dimension of the role. Job specific requirements: Proven track record of cross-functional leadership on large-scale transformation programs. Senior change management experience including strategy ownership, QA, and readiness governance. Strong program-level planning and risk management capability. System implementation experience (SAP, O9, Oracle, Salesforce, or equivalent) highly preferred. Travel requirements: Yes, but limited ( Work schedule: Hybrid — with on-site presence expectations commensurate with Program phase and governance cadence. The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland. No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary Mondelēz International, Inc. empowers people to snack right in over 150 countries around the world. We are leading the future of snacking with mouth-watering iconic brands such as Oreo , belVita , LU and Ritz biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk , Green & Blacks , Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Philadelphia and Dairylea cheese; and Maynards Bassetts , Trebor and Trident gums. Our more than 80,000 colleagues around the world are key to the success of our business. Great people and great brands. That’s who we are. Join us on our journey to continue leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. Product Operations Expert (m/f/d)
MF Group AG
Sede: Chiasso, Ticino, Svizzera
Company Description MF Group is a subsidiary of Riverty and part of the Bertelsmann Group. Around 120 employees work across two locations in Switzerland to make invoice-based purchasing with flexible installment payments even simpler and safer for Swiss retailers. As a leading Swiss provider, we are a key partner for the retail sector, combining credit checks, fraud prevention, invoicing, and pre-financing into a comprehensive end‑to‑end solution. In addition to our straightforward invoice payment solutions—both online and in‑store—we offer private customers flexible cash loans. We also issue a variety of payment cards. Our strength lies in managing complex projects where multiple sales channels and payment methods interact seamlessly. We work with nearly all major brick‑and‑mortar and online retailers in Switzerland, actively shaping the future of payments. Job Description We are looking for a Product Operations Expert (m/f/d) Permanent, full-time | Chiasso | Flexible working conditions available Job Responsibilities: As a Product Operations Expert , you will help ensure a smooth merchant journey and effective operations across MF Group’s payment solutions. Working closely with Product, Account Management, Risk Management, Sales and Engineering, you will connect merchant needs with technical execution and contribute to improving integration quality, operational efficiency and customer experience. In particular, you will: Manage merchant integrations end to end. Own and coordinate integrations from initial assessment to go-live, guiding merchants and integration partners towards scalable setups that meet their needs. This includes direct and PSP integrations, new feature adoption and PSP changes. Monitor performance and investigate issues. Analyze operational and integration performance across the merchant lifecycle, detect issues and performance degradation, conduct initial root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders. title: Social Media & Retail Assistant
motivazione: Hai: Digital Marketing, Brand / Positioning. Gap: Settore Luxury/Fashion
testo_completo: Social Media & Retail Assistant Social Media & Retail Assistant STAFF Agenzia per il Lavoro Genoa, Liguria, Italy 37 minutes ago Be among the first 25 applicants See who STAFF Agenzia per il Lavoro has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job STAFF Agenzia per il Lavoro provided pay range This range is provided by STAFF Agenzia per il Lavoro. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more. Base pay range €24,000.00/yr - €28,000.00/yr Per realtà storica del settore abbigliamento, operante nella fascia medio-alta, siamo alla ricerca di una persona da inserire nel team, con una forte passione per il mondo fashion e un particolare interesse per la comunicazione digitale, i social media e l'immagine del brand. La risorsa avrà un ruolo trasversale, occupandosi principalmente della gestione e dello sviluppo della presenza digitale dell'azienda, affiancando a queste attività il supporto alla vendita e alla gestione dell'esperienza del cliente all'interno delle boutique. Di cosa ti occuperai: Gestione e aggiornamento dei canali social aziendali, contribuendo alla pianificazione e alla pubblicazione dei contenuti; Creazione di contenuti digitali (foto, video, stories e reel), con particolare attenzione alla valorizzazione dei prodotti, delle collezioni e dell'identità del brand; Supporto nell'aggiornamento e nella gestione dei contenuti del sito web; Collaborazione con l'agenzia esterna di comunicazione per lo sviluppo delle attività digitali, la pianificazione editoriale e la realizzazione di contenuti; Supporto alle attività di comunicazione e promozione delle iniziative commerciali e delle nuove collezioni; Supporto alle attività di vendita assistita e consulenza personalizzata alla clientela, garantendo un'esperienza di acquisto curata e in linea con il posizionamento del brand; Cura dell'immagine del punto vendita, degli spazi espositivi e supporto alle attività di visual merchandising. Requisiti: Laurea triennale in Marketing, Comunicazione, Digital Marketing, Economia, Lingue o discipline affini; Esperienza, anche breve, nella gestione di canali social, creazione di contenuti digitali e/o attività di comunicazione online; Saranno apprezzate esperienze nel settore retail e nella vendita assistita, preferibilmente in ambito fashion; Interesse e familiarità con i principali social network (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok) e con le dinamiche della comunicazione digitale; Buona sensibilità estetica, creatività e attenzione all'immagine e al posizionamento del brand; Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative, orientamento al cliente e predisposizione al lavoro in team; Passione per il mondo della moda, del lifestyle e delle nuove tendenze. Cosa troverai: Entrerai a far parte di una realtà consolidata e riconosciuta sul territorio, in un ambiente dinamico e a stretto contatto con il mondo fashion. Avrai l'opportunità di ricoprire un ruolo vario e stimolante, che combina comunicazione digitale, gestione dei social media e attività di supporto alla vendita. L'azienda offre un contratto iniziale a tempo determinato, con concrete prospettive di inserimento a tempo indeterminato. L'inquadramento sarà definito in base all'esperienza e alle competenze della persona individuata, con livello 4° o 3° del CCNL Commercio. I candidati sono invitati a leggere l'informativa privacy nell'apposita sezione del sito web www.staff.it. Il presente annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, ai sensi della Legge 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03). Staff S.p.A. è azienda certificata UNI/PdR125:2022 per la Parità di Genere. Staff S.p.A. è iscritta all'Albo informatico delle Agenzie per il Lavoro sez. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Contents Federica Rizzo Federica Rizzo Contents is looking for a Revenue & Go-to-Market (GTM) Manager to join our team in Milan and play a key role in driving lead generation and accelerating our commercial growth across international markets. We help businesses integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) into their operations, from content creation to the orchestration of AI agents and workflows. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on, data-driven professional who wants to combine lead generation, commercial strategy and operational excellence in a fast-growing AI company. The role Reporting to the Head of Sales, your primary responsibility will be to generate qualified leads and build a strong, measurable sales pipeline, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Beyond lead generation, you will help build and optimise the processes, tools and insights that support our commercial organisation. You’ll collaborate with teams across Customer Success, Product, Tech and Finance to improve efficiency, strengthen collaboration and support growth throughout the customer lifecycle. What you’ll do 1. Lead Generation & Pipeline Development – Your primary focus and key responsibility. Define and continuously refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), analysing markets and identifying priority segments by industry, geography and company size. Plan, execute and optimise inbound, outbound and Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns in collaboration with Marketing and Sales. Build and enrich targeted account and contact lists, identify key decision-makers and maintain accurate, actionable prospect data. Set up and optimise outreach sequences, messaging, targeting and follow-up workflows using tools such as Apollo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Establish lead qualification criteria and nurturing processes, ensuring a clear progression from Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) to Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs), meetings and sales opportunities. Monitor lead quality, conversion rates and pipeline contribution, continuously testing new approaches and improving campaign performance based on data and Sales feedback. 2. GTM Strategy & Commercial Operations Map and optimise the end-to-end commercial funnel, from customer acquisition to closed-won and closed-lost analysis, renewals, expansion and upselling. Design and improve cross-functional processes and handovers across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance. Contribute to product-market fit analysis, pricing, positioning and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with Product, Marketing and commercial leadership. Develop a performance management framework with clear Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including conversion rates (CVR), churn, sales velocity, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Cost per Lead (CPL). Support the Head of Sales with target setting, incentive plans, commercial organisation, team sizing and capacity planning. 3. Sales & Marketing Enablement Manage and optimise Salesforce as our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform, including workflows, automation, data quality, lead scoring, routing and opportunity management. Manage and connect prospecting, enrichment and engagement tools, including LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and Lusha. Create and continuously improve sales decks, tailored presentations, industry-specific use cases, messaging frameworks and commercial playbooks. Translate product capabilities and customer needs into clear value propositions and compelling commercial materials to support prospecting, discovery, demos and deal progression. Coordinate corporate communication initiatives with Marketing across social media, blogs and company websites, ensuring alignment between content, campaigns and lead generation. Develop practical training materials and documentation to improve tool adoption, process consistency and team autonomy. 4. Reporting, Business Analytics & Forecasting Build and maintain dashboards covering lead generation, campaign performance, pipeline, revenue and retention, with visibility across markets, segments and channels. Support forecasting and commercial planning through reliable data, pipeline analysis and clear visibility into risks and opportunities. Prepare Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), consolidating performance results, progress against targets and actionable recommendations. What you’ll bring Proven experience in Lead Generation and Revenue Operations (RevOps), GTM Operations or Sales Operations, ideally within a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environment. A track record of planning and executing lead generation campaigns that generate qualified opportunities and measurable sales pipeline. Strong, hands-on experience with Salesforce, including administration, automation, dashboards and reporting. Practical experience with prospecting, enrichment and outreach tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha or similar platforms. A solid understanding of commercial funnel metrics, campaign optimisation, forecasting and performance management. Experience developing sales presentations, creating industry-specific use cases and translating complex solutions into compelling value propositions. A proactive, analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to turn insights into action and drive projects from implementation through adoption. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders. Fluency in both Italian and English. Nice to Have Experience working with international markets and multi-country go-to-market strategies. Familiarity with Clay, AI-powered tools and no-code automation platforms. Experience in a fast-growing technology company or startup environment. The Impact You’ll Have You’ll play a direct role in accelerating Contents’ commercial growth, starting with the generation of high-quality leads and qualified sales pipeline. Your contribution will also help improve conversion rates, forecasting accuracy and overall commercial productivity, giving our teams the processes, tools and insights they need to scale effectively across international markets. What We Offer A competitive salary package aligned with your experience and seniority. The opportunity to join a fast-growing international AI company. Exposure to global teams, enterprise clients and strategic international initiatives. The opportunity to play a key role in expanding Contents’ presence across Italy, Europe and the UK. The chance to shape and improve our commercial processes while contributing directly to the company’s growth. About Contents Contents is an AI-powered Software-as-a-Servic e (SaaS) platform that helps businesses create, manage and scale digital marketing and editorial content. Our platform supports global brands across industries including publishing, retail, luxury, financial services and automotive. Powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Contents enables personalised content creation and seamless integrations with Content Management Systems (CMS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, social media and other enterprise ecosystems. Backed by leading European and American venture capital firms, Contents is rapidly expanding its global presence and product offering. Equal Opportunity Contents is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and evaluate applicants regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion or disability. Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. A Day in the Life The Robotic Surgical Technologies business expands access to robotic-assisted surgery across Europe, helping surgeons and healthcare providers improve procedural consistency, clinical outcomes, and operational efficiency through advanced surgical technology. This is a remote position based in Western Europe and requires up to 75% travel across Europe. As Senior Marketing Program Manager, you will lead European marketing programs and market development initiatives that accelerate the adoption of robotic-assisted surgery. You will translate market, customer, and competitive insights into actionable growth strategies, partnering with regional and country teams to expand priority surgical specialties, strengthen customer engagement, and support commercial execution. Primary Responsibilities Develop and execute European growth strategies for robotic-assisted surgical technologies. Analyze market dynamics, procedure trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities. Define market segments, target customers, and strategic initiatives to accelerate procedure adoption. Lead cross-functional marketing programs across priority surgical specialties and European markets. Partner with country teams to plan and execute customer events, educational programs, and market development initiatives. Develop specialty-specific evidence, claims, messaging, tools, and performance frameworks aligned with market needs. Collaborate with Sales, Medical Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Customer Education, Regional Marketing, and Upstream Marketing to support commercial objectives. Build relationships with key opinion leaders and professional societies to advance education, advocacy, and market development. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing and 7+ years of marketing experience OR advanced degree in Marketing and 5+ years of marketing experience. Healthcare industry experience. Experience developing and executing market growth or commercial strategies. Experience leading cross-functional programs across multiple countries or stakeholder groups. Ability to travel up to 75% across Europe. Preferred Qualifications Experience in robotic-assisted surgery, medical devices, or surgical technologies. Knowledge of Urology, Gynecology, or General Surgery markets and procedures. Experience engaging key opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, or professional societies. Experience developing market segmentation, clinical evidence, claims, or procedure-adoption strategies. Experience in a regional or European marketing role. Si richiedono inoltre una conoscenza fluente della lingua inglese (costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza della lingua francese) ed un utilizzo avanzato dei principali applicativi di Office e di ERP aziendali (con preferenza per SAP). Completano il profilo una spiccata capacità di lavorare in autonomia e di sviluppare ed implementare piani strategici; ottime capacità relazionali e proattività nella proposizione di idee alternative. Want to contribute to the growth of a major global player in mountain sports? Founded in the French Alps, Rossignol has been inspiring the mountain experience since 1907. We carry on our legacy through the development of our ski, mountain bike, outdoor equipment and apparel collections. Our ambition is to be the benchmark for mountain sports in both summer and winter. In Milan, within an international environment, we are looking for a DTC Lead (M/W) ! Join our exciting journey and help us create unforgettable outdoor experiences year-round! As our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Lead, you will be responsible for driving the overall trading performance of our DTC business across both e-commerce and retail channels. You will define the commercial direction for the business, ensuring that P&L, assortment, inventory investment, trading decisions, operational excellence and profitability are aligned with consumer demand and business objectives. In this role, you will lead our e-commerce, retail and planning teams, translating insights into action and building a high-performing trading function and operational effectiveness focused on sustainable growth and commercial excellence. Your missions : Trading & Assortment Define and own the DTC assortment strategy across both e-commerce and retail channels to deliver weekly, monthly, quartery and annual budgets through a clear merchandising plan by channel aligned with marketing and category leadership Manage open-to-buy (OTB) with discipline, using in-season performance insights to guide investment decision that deliver weekly sales and margin goals while balancing inventory turn and productivity Take ownership of markdown and promotional decisions within established brand guidelines, understanding and managing the impact on margin performance Produce a weekly trading review, including performance analysis, recommendations and actions to drive results Channel P&L, Performance and Development Roadmap Own key DTC KPI metrics for all channels, including but not limited to contribution margin, inventory turn, traffic, conversion, AOV and units by transaction Align the Ecommerce Operations Roadmap with the commercial and merchandising strategy Build and Champion business case investments for retail development, digital platform investments and growth marketing spend Lead the annual forecasting and budgeting process for the channel, aligned with global commercial and finance Develop, implement and defend seasonal trading plans supported by clear KPIs and measurable objectives Identify and escalate assortment or inventory constraints impacting performance, providing data-driven recommendations and a clear commercial perspective Drive cost management and ensure disciplined control of operating expenses Team Management Lead, coach and develop e-commerce, retail and planning teams, setting priorities, removing obstacles and driving accountability for trading outcomes. Build a culture of entrepreneurship, cross-functional influence with the ability to operate in ambiguous fast moving business contexts Attract specialized skill sets, retain and develop Talents by providing continuous mentoring, learning and development Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Category Managers to share assortment feedback and consumer sell-through insights, acting as the primary voice of DTC customer demand within the product organization. Collaborate with the Marketing team to align promotional and campaign activity with trading priorities, ensuring a coordinated and consistent approach. Coordinate with Finance, Sales Operations, Inventory Supply Chain teams on financial and supply chain forecasting Build strong peer to peer relationships with Regional and Country Commercial Leaders to influence and support the global commercial strategies Your profile : Background Proven experience managing open-to-buy, markdown budgets and making commercial trading decisions in a fast-paced business setting. Experience trading across both physical retail and e-commerce channels, with a strong understanding of how assortment and promotional strategies differ by channel while supporting a common commercial objective. Previous experience leading, coaching or developing teams, with the credibility to provide clear direction and influence execution. Technical Skills Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify opportunities and translate insights into action. A solid understanding of DTC margin drivers, including assortment mix, pricing strategy, promotional activity and sell-through performance. Confidence to challenge, influence and advocate for the best commercial outcome. Comfortably operating within a business where DTC represents a smaller share of overall revenue, with the ability to effectively secure focus, resources and support. Lead through ambiguity, enabling decisive action and cultivating a culture of ownership, initiative, and entrepreneurial thinking. Soft Skills A strong sense of ownership and accountability, treating the DTC business as if it were your own. Clear and effective communication skills, particularly when managing escalation and decision-making. Comfortable leading in ambiguous situations Situational leadership and the ability to influence Motivated by building and improving capabilities, processes and performance rather than simply maintaining the status quo. Great interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence and ability to work in a multicultural environment. Excellent command of English, ability to speak Italian/French will be a plus. Joining the Group and its Rossignol brands also means : Continuing your career growth thanks to managers who care about the well-being and the development of their teams' skills, in particular through innovative projects Committing to cultural diversity , gender equality, and supporting the employment of people with disabilities within our company. Being proud to work for a responsible company committed to sustainability. Being part of a new and spacious office in Milan Benefiting from a flexible organization and the possibility of working remotely up to 2 days per week. Enjoying attractive prices on our brand , and much more. Livello retribuzione di base 50.000,00 €/yr - 55.000,00 €/anno Azienda leader in Italia nel settore dell’editoria professionale, informazione e soluzioni software per il mondo legale, fiscale e aziendale. La realtà fa parte di un primario gruppo multinazionale europeo ed opera offrendo strumenti tecnologici, software gestionali e contenuti ad altissimo valore aggiunto per accompagnare i professionisti e le imprese nella loro trasformazione digitale. Obiettivo del Ruolo La risorsa guiderà la strategia di Customer Growth & Value Management (CVM) end-to-end, con l’obiettivo di massimizzare la conversione dei prospect e il valore nel tempo ( Customer Lifetime Value ) della customer base. Attraverso un approccio fortemente data-driven , coordinerà la connessione strategica tra Lead Generation/Acquisition , Lead Nurturing e Customer Lifecycle Management (onboarding, engagement, cross/up-selling e retention), assicurando piena sinergia tra le funzioni Marketing, Sales, Prodotto e Data. Principali Responsabilità Lead Acquisition & Funnel Management: Definire strategie di lead generation, scoring, prioritizzazione e nurturing; ottimizzare i tassi di conversione e il passaggio qualificato dei lead alla forza commerciale. Customer Value Management (CVM): Segmentare la customer base (valore, comportamento, potenziale) e disegnare customer journey personalizzati e logiche di Next Best Action/Offer per favorire retention, renewal ed espansione (up-sell/cross-sell). Churn Prevention & Retention: Monitorare churn rate, engagement e CLTV, implementando iniziative di test & learn volte a massimizzare l'uplift incrementale. Governance End-to-End & Insight: Presidiare dashboard e KPI dell'intero funnel commerciale/relazionale, traducendo customer insight e modelli analitici in priorità di business per Marketing, Sales, Customer Care e Teleselling. MarTech & Marketing Automation: Collaborare con i team IT/Data per l’evoluzione dell'ecosistema CRM (Salesforce) e delle piattaforme di Marketing Automation / CDP. Requisiti Richiesti Esperienza: Almeno 5 anni in ruoli quali Customer Value Management , CRM Strategy , Lifecycle Marketing o Customer Analytics . Background di Settore: Comprovata esperienza su customer base a modello subscription / ricorsivo (SaaS, software B2B, servizi complessi o telco/utilities). Competenze Tecniche: Padronanza di logiche di segmentazione avanzata, trigger/campaign management e KPI di funnel (CLTV, CAC, Churn, Conversion Rate). Strumenti: Familiarità con ecosistemi CRM, CDP e Marketing Automation (la conoscenza di Salesforce costituisce un forte plus). Soft Skills: Approccio analitico e orientato al ROI, eccellenti capacità di stakeholder management e visione cross-funzionale. Lingue: Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese (gradita per interfacciarsi con il gruppo multinazionale). Cosa Offriamo RAL compresa tra 50-55.000 euro. La società opera a livello globale con un portafoglio di brand consolidati e una forte attenzione allo sviluppo omnicanale e all’eccellenza commerciale online. Il ruolo La figura avrà la responsabilità di guidare la crescita e le performance del business e-commerce a livello internazionale, gestendo clienti strategici online e supportando iniziative globali legate all’omnicanalità, alla digital shelf excellence e allo sviluppo commerciale. La risorsa collaborerà trasversalmente con team Sales, Marketing e stakeholder esterni, contribuendo all’identificazione di nuove opportunità di crescita e all’implementazione delle migliori strategie commerciali digitali. Principali responsabilità Gestire clienti e-commerce globali, sviluppando relazioni solide e sostenibili nel lungo periodo. Supportare le attività commerciali dei canali omnichannel e B&M.com, favorendo l’integrazione tra online e offline. Monitorare e analizzare le performance di sell-out, individuando opportunità di crescita e miglioramento. Definire linee guida per gli e-retailer, assicurando coerenza nella presenza del brand e nell’esecuzione sui diversi mercati. Standardizzare workflow e processi per il lancio di nuovi prodotti, garantendo un go-to-market efficace. Sviluppare e ottimizzare procedure di business development a supporto della crescita e-commerce internazionale. Gestire reportistica interna e presentazioni dedicate ai principali stakeholder aziendali. Supervisionare attività di price monitoring e progetti di digital shelf, assicurando competitività e coerenza del brand online. Collaborare allo sviluppo di strategie retail media, massimizzando visibilità e ROI sulle piattaforme digitali. Coordinarsi con licensor e partner esterni, garantendo allineamento rispetto alle linee guida e agli standard di brand. Profilo ricercato Esperienza consolidata in ambito e-commerce, digital sales o key account management, preferibilmente nei settori FMCG, beauty o consumer goods. Forte orientamento commerciale e mindset analitico. Esperienza nella gestione di clienti e stakeholder internazionali. Buona conoscenza di digital shelf, strategie pricing e retail media. Capacità di strutturare processi e guidare attività operative complesse. Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali. Approccio proattivo, orientamento ai risultati e capacità di lavorare in contesti dinamici e in evoluzione. Cosa offre l’azienda Pacchetto retributivo competitivo con bonus variabile. Ruolo strategico con esposizione internazionale. Opportunità di contribuire allo sviluppo e alla crescita del business e-commerce globale. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, internazionale e orientato all’innovazione. About Us The Bloc is the most diversified, fully independent health creative agency in the world. We provide comprehensive cross-channel services for audiences across the health spectrum, partnering with clients who are doing some of the most meaningful and exciting work in health today. As part of an international network of like-minded, independent agencies across the globe, our work continues to be recognized worldwide for creativity and innovation. Come build with us! We are looking for a Senior Digital Strategist to join our team, bringing solid experience in digital marketing and a strong ability to translate business and communication objectives into multichannel and omnichannel strategies. What you’ll do: Contribute to the development of multichannel and omnichannel digital strategies , seamlessly integrating channels, content, and touchpoints. Work on disease awareness campaigns , patient engagement initiatives , corporate communications , and HCP projects . Oversee both the strategic and operational aspects of digital activities , contributing to media planning, activation, and campaign optimization. Manage Social Media, Influencer Marketing, Digital Advertising, SEO/SEA, websites, and Analytics, working closely with internal and external specialists. Contribute to innovative projects , experimenting with emerging technologies and AI applications in communication. Participate in pitches , tenders , workshops , and strategic presentations , bringing fresh ideas, data-driven analysis, and actionable proposals. Monitor campaign performance , turning data into actionable insights and continuous optimization opportunities. Collaborate closely with cross-functional agency teams (Science, Strategic Planning, Creative, and Production). Operate in a strongly international environment , collaborating consistently with global teams and stakeholders, particularly our Basel office. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Economics , or a related field. At least 5–6 years of experience in Digital Marketing , preferably within a communication agency, digital agency, or consulting (experience in the pharma or healthcare sector is a strong plus). Hands-on knowledge of major advertising platforms and campaign management tools (Meta Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads). Strong command of core amplification tactics (SEO/GEO, SEA, paid social). Familiarity with web analytics, dashboarding, and performance measurement . Fluency in both Italian and English ( knowledge of German is a plus ). Willingness to travel as needed . What we offer: Salary range: €34,000 – €38,000 gross annual salary (the final compensation package will be determined following the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and seniority). Contract Type: Permanent contract regulated under the Italian CCNL Commercio, Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi (H011). Benefits: Daily meal vouchers (€8.00) and private health insurance. Work Model: Hybrid work policy (2 days per week in the office, 3 days remote). Do you have the skills, experience, and drive we are looking for at The Bloc? Please apply now! Descrizione del lavoro Entra nel team OBI! Cerchiamo un/una Digital Operations & Profitability Manager Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Digital Operations & Profitability Manager che contribuisca alla crescita del nostro business e-commerce, attraverso la gestione strategica dei processi operativi e l'ottimizzazione delle performance economiche, collaborando con i principali stakeholder aziendali per garantire efficienza e qualità del servizio al cliente. Chi siamo OBI è molto più di un'insegna di bricolage: è un brand internazionale, un player omnicanale, che fa parte di una multinazionale tedesca, leader in Europa nella Grande Distribuzione Specializzata nei mondi del Fai-da-te, Giardinaggio, Casa ed Edilizia. Con una presenza consolidata in 10 Paesi europei, OBI si distingue per l'attenzione al cliente, la continua innovazione e la capacità di integrare esperienza fisica e digitale. In Italia siamo presenti dai primi anni '90 e oggi contiamo 57 Punti Vendita, connessi ai nostri canali digitali per offrire un'esperienza sempre più integrata. Stiamo crescendo rapidamente, sia a livello nazionale che internazionale. Scopri di più su OBI Italia e preparati a far parte di un progetto in continua evoluzione. Attività principali Analizzare le performance economiche dell'e-commerce, monitorando vendite, marginalità e costi logistici al fine di ottimizzare la profittabilità del business. Gestire il Channel Management definendo la priorità delle fonti di approvvigionamento e le tariffe di spedizione più vantaggiose. Monitorare il processo di gestione degli ordini end-to-end, individuando criticità e coordinando le azioni correttive con le funzioni coinvolte. Collaborare con i principali stakeholder aziendali per implementare azioni correttive e supportare il testing di nuove funzionalità e-commerce. Requisiti Esperienza in ambito e-commerce operations o Supply Chain, preferibilmente maturata in contesti Retail, GDO o e-commerce strutturati. Spiccate capacità analitiche e familiarità con KPI economici e operativi, unite a un'ottima padronanza di Excel o Google Sheets. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, per l'interazione con interlocutori internazionali. Ci Piacerebbe Incontrare Una Persona Che Abbia Orientamento al risultato e capacità di problem solving. Assertività e autorevolezza nel proporre e sostenere le proprie decisioni. Capacità di collaborazione trasversale, anche in contesti internazionali. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un contesto internazionale, con l'opportunità di contribuire concretamente allo sviluppo e all'ottimizzazione del business e-commerce di OBI Italia. 2° livello CCNL Distribuzione Moderna Organizzata. RAL compresa tra €33.000 e €35.000 più MBO. Livello retribuzione di base 50.000,00 €/yr - 55.000,00 €/anno Il nostro cliente è una realtà operante nel settore Beauty, in fortissima crescita a livello internazionale, distribuita sul canale Profumeria Selettiva e Department Stores . Posizione Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Export Manager che contribuisca allo sviluppo del business sui mercati internazionali, attraverso la gestione e il consolidamento dei clienti strategici e l'identificazione di nuove opportunità commerciali. Il ruolo prevede le seguenti responsabilità: Gestione dei clienti internazionali: sviluppare e consolidare le relazioni con Key Account, distributori e partner commerciali sui mercati esteri, garantendo partnership solide e durature. Sviluppo del business: identificare nuove opportunità di crescita e sviluppo commerciale, contribuendo all'espansione della presenza del brand sui mercati internazionali. Gestione commerciale: definire e monitorare obiettivi di vendita, budget, forecast e KPI, assicurando il raggiungimento dei target assegnati. Trade Marketing: collaborare allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di piani commerciali e promozionali dedicati ai diversi mercati, in linea con il posizionamento del brand. Negoziazione commerciale: gestire le trattative con clienti e distributori, definendo condizioni commerciali, politiche di prezzo e accordi annuali. Analisi di mercato: monitorare trend, competitor, dinamiche distributive e performance dei mercati, individuando opportunità di sviluppo. Coordinamento cross-funzionale: collaborare con le funzioni Marketing, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain e Finance per garantire un'efficace implementazione delle strategie commerciali. Monitoraggio delle performance: analizzare i risultati di vendita e la redditività dei clienti, identificando eventuali azioni correttive e opportunità di miglioramento. Requisiti La risorsa ideale soddisfa i seguenti requisiti: 5–7 anni di esperienza maturata in ruoli Sales, Key Account Management e/o Trade Marketing , nel settore Beauty & Cosmetics . Esperienza nella gestione di clienti, distributori o partner commerciali internazionali. Buona conoscenza del mercato Beauty, dei canali distributivi e delle dinamiche del canale. Solide capacità commerciali, negoziali e di sviluppo del business. Buone capacità analitiche e familiarità con la gestione di budget, forecast e KPI. Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative, con attitudine alla gestione di interlocutori internazionali. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; la conoscenza di ulteriori lingue costituisce un plus. Disponibilità a trasferte internazionali. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro TRANSFORM THE WORLD OF CONSTRUCTION: BUILD PARTNERSHIPS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE The Strategic Business Developer – Power is responsible for defining and driving Hilti’s long-term strategy across a selected portfolio of strategically relevant and complex customer hierarchies in Power Generation and Renewables. The role develops senior and C-suite relationships, identifies customer needs, and translates them into account strategies, business priorities and scalable growth initiatives across countries, business units, sites and projects. The SBD leads the Customer Engagement Team (CET) through direct leadership and orchestrates KAMs and relevant cross-functional resources to deliver sustainable, profitable growth. The role acts as Hilti’s primary strategic interface for assigned customers and ensures alignment between customer priorities and Hilti’s global, regional and local execution. What You'll Do Define and continuously develop the long-term account strategy and Account Development Plans for assigned Power customer hierarchies. Lead the CET, setting direction and priorities for KAMs, RE and collaborating with CPM, Business Developers, Engineering, Technical Services, Marketing, Logistics, Finance, Customer Service and other relevant functions. Develop and maintain relationships with C-suite executives, business leaders and key decision makers, positioning Hilti as a strategic partner for productivity, safety and sustainability. Identify and prioritize growth opportunities, own and be accountable for the development of standards and specifications across the managed platform of accounts. Ensure account strategies and business priorities are localized and executed across the main customer offices, subsidiaries, projects, plants and relevant ecosystem partners. Own strategic pipeline governance and ensure sufficient qualified opportunities to deliver the agreed Net Sales, Share of Wallet and profitability ambitions. Sponsor and steer major opportunities, supporting early engagement, specification, standardization, project capture and commercial closure. Lead strategic negotiations for long-term partnerships, framework agreements and customer-wide initiatives. Ensure accurate customer hierarchy, stakeholder, priority and opportunity information in Salesforce and disciplined use of the Large & Complex Sales Management Process. Act as the internal Power segment reference, bringing market intelligence, customer insights and input to offering, competence and go-to-market development. What You’ll Bring '- Master’s degree in engineering or higher education Extensive (5+ years) successful experience in strategic business development, key account management or commercial leadership within Energy or Industry fields Proven ability to develop large and complex customer hierarchies and engage credibly with senior executives and C-suite stakeholders. Strong understanding of Power Generation and Renewable Energy markets, customer value chains, project lifecycles and commercial models. Demonstrated capability to define account strategy, prioritize investments and convert long-term customer needs into executable growth plans. Strong negotiation, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority. Commercial acumen and accountability for sustainable growth, pipeline quality, Share of Wallet and profitability. Structured, proactive and self-driven working style, with the ability to operate effectively across geographies and in a matrix organization. Excellent English communication skills; additional languages are an advantage. Willingness to travel regularly across the assigned customer and geographic scope What’s In It for You Continuous learning: personalized coaching, on-the-job training and dedicated development opportunities. Career growth: you will have the opportunity to progressively broaden your responsibilities and develop your skills within an international environment. Strategic customers and complex projects: you will work closely with major players in the industry, senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams, contributing to the development of long-term partnerships. Autonomy and responsibility: you will have the freedom to define strategies and priorities for your accounts, supported by the different areas of expertise across the Hilti organization. Our benefits: welcome box, meal allowance, supplementary health insurance and an annual welfare package. Compensation and Employment Terms Permanent, full-time employment contract Employment classification under the Italian National Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL) for the Commerce Sector, Level Q Annual Gross Salary (RAL) + target variable compensation of no less than €68,000 The actual compensation package will be determined based on objective criteria, including professional experience, technical skills, level of responsibility associated with the role, and qualifications, in line with the principles of fairness, transparency, and equal pay opportunities. Why Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. Commitment to Inclusion At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. About The Role The Senior Director, Advertiser Solutions is a strategically critical commercial leadership role in Italy, based in Milan, reporting to the VP, Advertiser Solutions EMEA. You will own and drive end-to-end demand-side commercial strategy, building senior executive relationships with holding companies, independent agencies, and brand-direct advertisers. Italy is a significant programmatic market with established agency infrastructure, strong brand presence, and growing demand-side sophistication. Your role is to drive PubMatic's share of wallet in this high-value market, unlock Brand-Direct and premium advertiser budgets, position Activate, PubMatic's unified platform for buying directly in the SSP, as the default route to market, accelerate adoption of strategic formats (PMP, CTV, curated deals), and build a scalable, compounding revenue engine that translates to measurable market leadership. As the most senior commercial voice for PubMatic in Italy, you will act as a trusted strategic advisor to clients, serve as a key regional industry figure, and collaborate cross-functionally to align Sales, Supply, and Product priorities, ensuring that PubMatic is positioned as the premium strategic partner in the market. Key Responsibilities Regional Demand Strategy & Revenue Ownership Make Activate, PubMatic's unified platform for buying directly in the SSP, your primary commercial priority, driving adoption with agencies, brand-direct advertisers, and DSPs across Italy. Own and scale programmatic demand across Italy, setting and executing a multi-year commercial strategy aligned with EMEA and PubMatic objectives. Build and own revenue targets, with accountability for structured pipeline development, revenue growth, and long-term market leadership. Serve as the primary regional growth lead, aligning Sales, Supply, and Product priorities locally to build a sustainable demand–supply ecosystem. Develop a phased market development roadmap, from strengthening relationships with Holding Companies and independent agencies to unlocking high-value Brand-Direct and premium advertiser budgets. Client Acquisition & Senior Relationship Management Drive net new client acquisition onto Activate and into the PubMatic supply chain, working closely with EMEA leadership and the wider Advertiser Solutions team. Build and maintain senior executive relationships at C-suite, CMO, and Head of Programmatic level with Italian Holding Companies (GroupM, Publicis, IPG, Omnicom, Dentsu), independent agencies, direct brand advertisers, and DSPs. Scale structured, predictable revenue by elevating PubMatic from tactical vendor to strategic partner, ensuring adoption of PMPs, curated deals, and long-term revenue visibility. Identify and pursue strategic partnership opportunities with major agency groups and premium brands that materially impact PubMatic's revenue and market positioning. Conduct regular executive business reviews and manage senior client relationships on an ongoing basis. Premium Supply & Format Activation Work closely with Publisher Development to strengthen relationships with key regional publishers, broadcasters, and premium content creators. Drive adoption and monetization of premium formats, particularly PMP, CTV (where growing significantly), and curated deals, positioning them as strategic priorities. Lead local follow-through on global programmatic agreements, converting international commitments into regional revenue. Drive adoption of Activate as the unified platform for buying directly in the SSP, and scale Buyer Marketplaces to accelerate adoption of high-value programmatic formats and curated supply. Strategic Advisor & Market Leadership Act as a trusted strategic advisor to clients, leading with Activate, PubMatic's unified platform for buying directly in the SSP, alongside curated supply, PMP, and audience intelligence, to deliver tailored, ROI-maximizing solutions. Represent PubMatic as a senior commercial voice at key regional industry events, conferences, and networking forums to build brand equity, generate pipeline, and reinforce PubMatic's market commitment. Provide executive-level market intelligence, competitive insights, and regional feedback to EMEA and global leadership to inform investment and product decisions. Engage senior agency stakeholders to challenge existing approaches and position PubMatic as a strategic supply-side partner. Share market insights and contribute to thought leadership in the regional advertising ecosystem. Product Strategy & Collaboration Partner with product leadership to provide market-level feedback, support product/market fit initiatives, and advocate for solutions relevant to Italy. Maintain awareness of AI-driven innovation, emerging technology, automation, and programmatic evolution to guide client solutions and internal strategy. Foster strong working relationships with regional leaders, local commercial teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure strategic alignment and execution. Provide structured feedback to Product and Technology teams on regional requirements and emerging market needs. Requirements Experience & Expertise Significant and progressive experience in senior sales, business development, or commercial leadership roles within digital advertising or ad-tech (SSP, DSP, ad exchange, publisher, agency trading desk, ad network). Proven track record of building and scaling regional commercial operations, with demonstrable revenue growth and market development achievements. Deep experience managing and growing complex relationships with Holding Companies, independent agencies, and Brand-Direct advertisers at senior levels. Established network within the Italian advertising and media ecosystem, with key agency, brand, publisher, and industry contacts, is strongly preferred. Industry Knowledge Comprehensive understanding of programmatic advertising landscape, including RTB, PMP, curated deals, CTV/video, and buy-side supply chain. Hands-on understanding of direct buying in the SSP and of unified platforms such as Activate, including how they simplify supply access, deal execution, and buyer workflows. Strong knowledge of programmatic buying strategies, pricing models, optimization techniques, audience intelligence, and how agencies and brands structure media investment. Proactive, adaptable, and collaborative, able to build consensus across global and regional teams while maintaining autonomy to move quickly. Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Fluency in English required, including the ability to write reports and business communications in English to a senior professional standard; fluency in Italian is a distinct advantage. LOGICAL JOB Srl ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da LOGICAL JOB Srl. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 60.000,00 €/yr - 65.000,00 €/anno Logical Job , società specializzata in consulenza HR, con un forte orientamento alla valorizzazione del Capitale Umano, ricerca per un'importante realtà industriale operante nel settore alimentare un/una Direttore Vendite . La risorsa, riportando alla Direzione Commerciale e operando in stretto raccordo con la Direzione Generale, avrà la responsabilità di guidare e sviluppare le attività commerciali sui mercati italiani ed esteri, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di fatturato, marginalità e crescita aziendale. Posizione Il ruolo prevede un'importante responsabilità sullo sviluppo del mercato internazionale (circa il 75%) e il coordinamento di un team composto da 5 Sales Account. Principali responsabilità Definire e implementare il piano commerciale in coerenza con gli obiettivi strategici aziendali, individuando priorità di sviluppo per Paese, settore e segmento di mercato. Guidare, coordinare e motivare la rete vendita, assegnando obiettivi, monitorando le performance e supportando la crescita professionale dei Sales Account. Sviluppare il business sui mercati esteri, consolidando le relazioni con distributori, partner internazionali e clienti strategici. Individuare nuove opportunità commerciali, analizzare i mercati di riferimento e sviluppare nuovi canali distributivi. Presidiare le relazioni con i principali clienti, supportando il team nelle trattative strategiche e nelle negoziazioni complesse. Contribuire alla definizione del budget commerciale, monitorare fatturato, marginalità, pricing e scostamenti rispetto agli obiettivi. Supervisionare pipeline commerciale e forecast, individuando tempestivamente eventuali azioni correttive. Collaborare con Produzione, Operations, Marketing e Logistica per garantire coerenza tra sviluppo commerciale, capacità produttiva e gestione degli ordini. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di Direzione Vendite presso aziende di produzione del settore alimentare. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di budget commerciali e nello sviluppo di mercati internazionali. Esperienza nel coordinamento e nella gestione di team commerciali. Solide competenze in pianificazione commerciale, analisi della marginalità, pricing, gestione della pipeline e previsioni di vendita. Spiccate capacità manageriali, leadership, negoziazione e orientamento ai risultati. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; la conoscenza di una seconda lingua straniera costituisce titolo preferenziale. Disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e all'estero. Completano il profilo Leadership, visione strategica, capacità di analisi e pianificazione, orientamento al business e attitudine a costruire relazioni commerciali solide e durature. La persona ideale sa coniugare visione strategica e presenza operativa, accompagnando il team nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Altre informazioni Inquadramento: Quadro. Livello retribuzione di base 70.000,00 €/yr - 95.000,00 €/anno Axitea S.p.A., Global Security Provider e Partner di riferimento per la sicurezza integrata e gestita di realtà come AC Milan, Comune di Milano, Lega del Filo d’Oro, Lube Industries, GLS. Axitea progetta, realizza e sviluppa le soluzioni più adeguate ai bisogni del cliente e alle sue esigenze di sicurezza fisica e informatica. L'innovazione applicata alla sicurezza è uno dei nostri principali driver: ci consente sempre di essere due passi in avanti! Il ruolo La risorsa sarà responsabile dello sviluppo e della valorizzazione dell'ecosistema di partnership e canali indiretti dell'azienda, contribuendo alla crescita del business attraverso l'attivazione e la gestione di relazioni strategiche. In particolare, si occuperà di: Definire e sviluppare la strategia dei canali indiretti, individuando e attivando partnership strategiche nell'ambito Telco e ICT; Costruire e gestire accordi commerciali con partner, definendo modelli di collaborazione, governance e meccanismi di incentivazione; Sviluppare iniziative di go-to-market, co-selling e business development finalizzate alla generazione di pipeline, opportunità commerciali e ricavi; Coordinare l'onboarding, l'abilitazione e l'attivazione dei partner, favorendone l'integrazione con la rete vendita, il marketing e l'offerta aziendale; Monitorare le performance del canale e promuovere azioni finalizzate ad aumentare il contributo dei partner ai risultati di business; Supportare l'integrazione commerciale delle società acquisite, valorizzando sinergie, partnership e opportunità di cross-selling. Si prendono in considerazione candidature provenienti da Milano e da Roma. Il profilo ideale Esperienza pluriennale nello sviluppo di partnership commerciali, canali indiretti o alleanze strategiche nei settori ICT, Cybersecurity, Telecomunicazioni o Digital Services; Conoscenza delle dinamiche di collaborazione con operatori Telco, system integrator, distributori, MSP e partner tecnologici; Esperienza nella negoziazione e gestione di accordi commerciali e iniziative di business con partner strategici; Capacità di sviluppare relazioni di lungo periodo con interlocutori di livello executive e di coordinare stakeholder interni ed esterni; Familiarità con strumenti CRM, reporting commerciale e monitoraggio delle performance di canale; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Costituirà titolo preferenziale aver maturato esperienze nella gestione di ecosistemi di partnership in ambito Cybersecurity, Managed Services, Cloud o Telecomunicazioni. Cosa offriamo È prevista una retribuzione fissa tra € 70.000 e € 95.000, commisurata all’esperienza, con sistema di MBO; Inserimento in un contesto strutturato e in crescita nel settore della sicurezza e della trasformazione digitale; Ruolo strategico e ad elevata visibilità, con responsabilità diretta nello sviluppo dell'ecosistema commerciale e dei canali indiretti dell'azienda; Opportunità di costruire e consolidare partnership di rilievo con operatori Telco, system integrator, distributori e partner tecnologici; Un brand forte, riconosciuto per innovazione, competenza e affidabilità nel mercato della sicurezza; Autonomia e possibilità di contribuire alla definizione delle strategie commerciali e di crescita aziendale; Formazione continua (tecnica, manageriale e commerciale); Portale convenzioni dedicato ai dipendenti Axitea, con un'attenzione al benessere psicologico del dipendente; Ambiente che valorizza collaborazione, imprenditorialità, crescita e orientamento al risultato. Chi cerchiamo Persone motivate, orientate alle relazioni e desiderose di costruire un percorso di lungo periodo con passione. Valutiamo le competenze, ma ancor di più la volontà di crescere con noi, contribuendo a un ambiente positivo e ad alte prestazioni. C'è un momento nella carriera di ogni professionista delle Agenzie per il Lavoro in cui nasce una domanda importante: continuare a gestire ciò che esiste o diventare protagonista di qualcosa di nuovo. In Ali Lavoro stiamo vivendo una fase di crescita straordinaria. Oggi siamo una realtà composta da oltre 460 persone e 75 filiali sul territorio nazionale, con un ambizioso piano di espansione che prevede l'apertura di 37 nuove filiali entro il 2030. La crescita delle persone è un elemento concreto della nostra strategia di sviluppo. Segnala offerta di lavoro This role is in the UPS Healthcare division which operates in the logistics and distribution market supporting pharmaceutical, med tech and diagnostics companies. Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with highly talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities to lead yourself and work well in a team, this is a role ready to reward and cultivate your skills and take you to the next level. Office: Peschiera Borromeo (Milan) and remote FUTURE YOU Are you ready to positively impact the organization by leading the sales initiative for top priority UPS Healthcare product In the role of Business Development Manager for HealthTech you will be asked to build a pipeline and secure new revenue for our European HealthTech offerings. UPS HealthTech™ is a specialized service offered by UPS Healthcare that focuses on the end-to-end logistics of high-tech medical equipment. This service is designed to address the unique challenges associated with complex transporting and often expensive (large) medical devices including white glove services, management of demopool equipment and providing field services. You will work closely with our Enterprise and Small Medium Business sales team to do this along with your own self led efforts based on your knowledge of the market. We’ll offer you a compensation package equal to the experiences you gain. If you demonstrate positive capabilities, attitude and results, there will be many opportunities for you to grow your career and upskill on greater level within UPS. What you’ll do Drive profitable business growth and achieve sales targets. Generate and qualify leads Receive and work leads from European and Global Sales partners Source and develop client referrals Hunt, negotiate and win new HealthTech business for Italy and Europe Manage the entire sales process, from prospecting and opportunity qualification through negotiation and contract closure. Develop compelling value propositions that demonstrate clear customer benefits. Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful solution design and implementation. Collaborate closely with our Peschiera operations team to ensure alignment and smooth execution Respond quickly and effectively to customer enquiries and business opportunities. Develop and maintain a customer pipeline using Salesforce CRM Develop and implement strategic sales action plans to achieve targets Lead and deliver commercial proposal development working with our tender management team What We're Looking For Commercial & Sales Expertise Proven success in business development and new customer acquisition. Experience managing complex sales cycles and negotiations. Strong commercial acumen and opportunity qualification skills. Ability to create and communicate compelling customer value propositions. Experience planning and executing revenue growth strategies. Healthcare Industry Knowledge Knowledge of Medical Devices market and its key stakeholders. Established network of logistics decision-makers within the medical device industry is big advantage Knowledge and experience with white glove delivery services for Medical Device equipment Knowledge of hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers is a plus Knowledge of national and international transportation Familiarity with healthcare regulations and compliance requirements. Skills & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business or Supply Chain Management At least 5 years of experience within the logistics industry. Strong hunter mentality with a passion for generating new business. Fluent in Italian and English, both written and spoken. Additional language skills are a plus. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to contribute to new products, services, and business initiatives. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Strong negotiation and influencing abilities. Proactive, flexible, and results-driven approach. Solid financial knowledge and understanding Flexible attitude What we offer Permanent employment contract. Competitive salary package with performance-based bonus. Company car. Structured onboarding programme. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Access to industry-leading training initiatives. Clear career progression within a global market leader. Exposure to strategic international projects and healthcare innovation programmes. The opportunity to join a fast-growing organization investing in its people and future growth. How we recruit: UPS is committed to a policy of treating individuals fairly and recruiting, selecting, training, promoting and compensating based on merit, experience and other work-related criteria. We do not discriminate against any applicant based on age, race, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity. Livello retribuzione di base 50.000,00 €/yr - 70.000,00 €/anno Il nostro cliente è un gruppo italiano in forte espansione, specializzato nella commercializzazione e distribuzione di prodotti agroalimentari attraverso un modello di business multicanale. Nell'ambito di un importante percorso di crescita e consolidamento, il Gruppo sta investendo nella trasformazione digitale della filiera, nell'ottimizzazione dei processi operativi e nell'integrazione tecnologica delle società acquisite, con l'obiettivo di costruire un ecosistema organizzativo e applicativo integrato, efficiente e scalabile. Posizione La risorsa, inserita come Head of IT & Digital Transformation e a diretto riporto del Board, avrà la responsabilità di definire e guidare la roadmap tecnologica del Gruppo, con particolare focus sulla digitalizzazione dei processi, sull'unificazione del panorama applicativo e sull'integrazione dei sistemi informativi della capogruppo e delle società acquisite. In particolare, si occuperà di: Definire e implementare la strategia IT e di Digital Transformation del Gruppo. Guidare la digitalizzazione e la standardizzazione dei processi aziendali. Governare l'unificazione, l'integrazione e la razionalizzazione dell'intero ecosistema applicativo, garantendo interoperabilità, condivisione dei dati e scalabilità delle soluzioni a livello di Gruppo. Gestire attività di software selection e project management, con particolare riferimento a ERP, WMS, TMS, Fleet Management e Data Analytics. Coordinare partner tecnologici, software house e società di consulenza nelle attività di sviluppo e integrazione applicativa. Promuovere l'adozione di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale e automazione dei processi. Collaborare con il Board nell'individuazione di opportunità di finanziamento pubblico per progetti di innovazione digitale. Strutturare progressivamente la funzione IT interna e presidiare l'evoluzione tecnologica del Gruppo. Requisiti Consolidata esperienza in ruoli di IT Management, Digital Transformation, IT Project Management o Technology Consulting. Esperienza in progetti di digitalizzazione, software selection, migrazione e consolidamento di ecosistemi applicativi eterogenei. Conoscenza di applicativi ERP, WMS, TMS e soluzioni tecnologiche a supporto della logistica e della supply chain. Buona comprensione delle architetture software, delle logiche di system integration, delle API e delle tecnologie di AI e automazione. Capacità di coordinare fornitori tecnologici e interfacciarsi con stakeholder tecnici, operativi e direzionali. Approccio pragmatico, autonomia decisionale e forte orientamento al business. Preferibile provenienza da società di consulenza tecnologica, con esperienza nei settori Food & Beverage, distribuzione, logistica o supply chain. È Microsoft Solutions Partner per Modern Work e nel 2025 è stata riconosciuta come Microsoft Partner of the Year per Copilot & Agents. Favorisce l’adozione efficace di strumenti digitali e modelli di lavoro evoluti combinando competenze tecnologiche, psicologia organizzativa, scienze sociali e data-driven insights per accompagnare il cambiamento in modo misurabile e sostenibile. Lavora con ecosistemi tecnologici e partnership strategiche, in particolare con Microsoft, per integrare innovazione, produttività e workplace transformation. Ci rivolgiamo a imprese, PMI e grandi organizzazioni che stanno affrontando percorsi di trasformazione digitale, adozione di AI, evoluzione del workplace e cambiamento organizzativo, in contesti caratterizzati da elevata complessità e impatto sulle persone. È parte di Digital360 Advisory , la Business Unit di Digital360, che supporta e organizzazioni nel definire e mettere a terra strategie di trasformazione e modelli operativi. Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento. Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di una persona che ricopra la posizione di Product Owner . Il ruolo nasce con l’obiettivo di presidiare il Product Ownership degli asset proprietari di Digital Attitude, guidandone l’evoluzione strategica e funzionale in coerenza con i bisogni del mercato, dei clienti e del business aziendale. La persona avrà la responsabilità di raccogliere insight provenienti da clienti, mercato, stakeholder interni e attività di delivery, trasformandoli in evoluzioni strutturate dell’offerta e dei prodotti proprietari aziendali. La persona definirà roadmap e priorità evolutive, coordinerà la gestione del backlog e favorirà l’allineamento tra Sales, Delivery, Product & Tech e stakeholder interni. Il valore distintivo del ruolo risiede nella capacità di connettere visione di prodotto, opportunità di mercato, feedback dei clienti e sostenibilità degli investimenti, assicurando che gli asset generino valore concreto e scalabile. Principali responsabilità: Product Ownership of Proprietary Products Presidiare l’evoluzione funzionale e strategica degli asset proprietari di Digital Attitude, inclusi Hi Platform, Copilot Go, Collection, gamification, dashboard e futuri acceleratori aziendali. Definire e mantenere una roadmap evolutiva degli asset, individuando priorità, dipendenze e opportunità di sviluppo. Gestire backlog e requisiti evolutivi, raccogliendo e consolidando input da clienti, mercato, Sales, Delivery, Product & Tech e stakeholder interni. Collaborare con Product & Tech nella definizione delle evoluzioni funzionali, contribuendo alla traduzione delle esigenze in requisiti chiari e prioritizzati. Valutare nuove opportunità di innovazione e ampliamento dell’offerta, con particolare attenzione all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema Microsoft, Copilot, AI e digital adoption. Assicurare coerenza tra visione di prodotto, investimenti richiesti, effort di sviluppo e risultati attesi per clienti e business. Presidiare il ciclo di vita degli asset, dalla raccolta dell’esigenza alla definizione della priorità, fino al rilascio e alla capitalizzazione del valore generato. Offering Strategy & Commercial Enablement Collaborare con il team Sales nella definizione delle proposte commerciali relative agli asset proprietari, assicurando coerenza tra valore offerto, posizionamento e capability disponibili. Essere il riferimento interno per il posizionamento funzionale degli asset proprietari e per la costruzione delle relative value proposition. Proporre evoluzioni dell’offerta sulla base delle esigenze di mercato, dei feedback dei clienti e delle evidenze raccolte nei progetti. Supportare la definizione di packaging, pricing hypothesis e modelli di commercializzazione, in accordo con Sales e con il management. Contribuire alla realizzazione e all’aggiornamento di materiali commerciali, schede prodotto, demo narrative e contenuti a supporto della proposizione al mercato. Favorire la diffusione della conoscenza degli asset presso i team commerciali e di delivery, abilitando un utilizzo più coerente e scalabile delle soluzioni proprietarie. Product Governance & Portfolio Evolution Contribuire alla definizione della strategia complessiva di evoluzione del portfolio di prodotti proprietari Digital Attitude. Supportare la prioritizzazione degli investimenti tra asset esistenti e nuove iniziative, tenendo conto di impatto business, effort, maturità dell’offerta e bisogni di mercato. Monitorare feedback, utilizzo, adozione e performance degli asset, identificando aree di miglioramento e possibili evoluzioni. Identificare gap di mercato, opportunità di standardizzazione e nuove occasioni di sviluppo di asset riutilizzabili. Promuovere una gestione più strutturata e scalabile dei prodotti proprietari, favorendo modelli operativi, cicli di review e criteri di priorità condivisi. Assicurare che le evoluzioni degli asset siano coerenti con la strategia aziendale e con il posizionamento complessivo di Digital Attitude. Governance del ruolo Riporto diretto al Head of Digital Solutions. Allineamento ricorrente con Sales per le proposte commerciali e con Product & Tech per roadmap, backlog e priorità evolutive. Revisione periodica della roadmap degli asset proprietari e delle priorità di investimento, in coerenza con le esigenze di mercato e con la strategia aziendale. Definizione di obiettivi SMART legati all’evoluzione misurabile degli asset, alla qualità della roadmap, all’adozione e al valore generato per clienti e business. Competenze e capacità richieste: Product Ownership: Gestire roadmap, backlog, priorità e ciclo di vita degli asset proprietari, orientando le evoluzioni verso valore cliente e valore business. Product Strategy: Leggere bisogni di mercato, feedback clienti e opportunità di innovazione, trasformandoli in direzioni evolutive sostenibili. Commercial Enablement: Collaborare con Sales per costruire value proposition, materiali e proposte commerciali coerenti con l’offerta proprietaria. Stakeholder Management: Allineare stakeholder interni ed esterni, facilitando decisioni, priorità e responsabilità chiare tra funzioni diverse. Prioritization & Governance: Valutare impatto, effort, dipendenze e sostenibilità, contribuendo a una gestione strutturata del portfolio proprietario. Microsoft, AI & Digital Adoption Acumen: Comprendere il contesto Microsoft 365, Copilot, AI e digital adoption per orientare soluzioni e asset proprietari in modo coerente.
