Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business. Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible. Job Description As Subscription Manager, you will own a portfolio of customer subscriptions and coordinate the end-to-end commercial lifecycle. You will identify commercial drift, build and maintain a Commercial Roadmap by subscription, recommend the appropriate commercial play at the right time, forecast renewal and broader commercial outcomes, and drive quote-to-booking readiness. You will move beyond executing renewals to orchestrating commercial outcomes. Working as a trusted commercial advisor, you will align the customer lifecycle state, account strategy, terms, conditions, pricing logic, renewal pathways, and policy-aligned options to balance value delivered to customers and value captured by PTC. Ownership is expressed through accountability, insight, influence, and disciplined follow-through. Key Responsibilities Manage assigned subscription portfolio and drive the end-to-end renewal lifecycle to deliver customer value, retention, and sustainable commercial outcomes. Develop and maintain a clear commercial roadmap for assigned accounts, including renewal strategy, customer state, risks, opportunities, dependencies, and next steps. Provide commercial guidance to customers and account teams by connecting contract structure, pricing, product configuration, policy requirements, and account strategy. Identify customer lifecycle state , renewal risk, downgrade signals, modernization opportunities, growth potential, and commercial drift early and recommend appropriate commercial actions. Identify and address commercial drift across contract structure, pricing, discounting, product configuration, renewal pathways, and terms & conditions to maintain commercial alignment over time. Forecast renewal and commercial outcomes accurately by maintaining complete, current, and decision-ready data, documentation, and pipeline hygiene. Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, and other teams to progress the agreed commercial motion. Drive quote-to-booking readiness, timely customer engagement, and disciplined follow-through to reduce late surprises and improve business predictability. Support adoption of strategic initiatives, tools, processes, and programs. Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing best practices, strengthening knowledge management, and helping scale consistent Subscription Management execution. Demonstrate PTC values through customer focus, accountability, collaboration, integrity, and a commitment to professional, inclusive, and ethical business conduct. What Success Looks Like A successful Senior Subscription Manager consistently delivers strong renewal performance, ARR retention, and sustainable commercial outcomes by owning the end-to-end commercial lifecycle for the assigned portfolio. Curiosity, a strong learning mindset, and the willingness to build deep expertise in PTC’s products, policies, systems, customer motions, and evolving strategic programs are essential. In a fast-paced, changing environment, the role requires energy, confidence, organization, resilience, and an outcome-focused approach while managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and time-sensitive customer or business needs. The successful candidate diagnoses customer state early, identifies churn risk and downgrade signals, maintains a high-quality Commercial Roadmap, and provides accurate, decision-ready forecasts that improve business predictability. S trong performance also depends on robust, trust-based relationships with customers, partners, account teams, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, and other teams, using clear communication, sound judgment, and disciplined follow-through to progress the right commercial play. What good looks like also means being a positive team player who shares knowledge, asks for and offers help, reinforces consistent ways of working, contributes to continuous improvement, and helps others succeed. The role exemplifies PTC values through customer focus, accountability, collaboration, integrity, inclusive behavior, openness to feedback, responsible decision-making, and a commitment to doing the right thing for customers, colleagues, and the business. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required. Business, Management, Technology, Engineering, or related discipline preferred. Experience in enterprise software, SaaS, PLM, CAD, or technology industries. Experience coordinating stakeholders across international teams and complex regional business environments. Familiarity with CRM and forecasting systems such as Salesforce. Experience 5+ years of experience in subscription management, renewals, customer success, commercial operations, sales, licensing, or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing complex renewals and commercial negotiations. Strong experience managing recurring revenue, customer retention, forecasting, and renewal-focused business motions. Experience working independently in cross-functional and international business environments. Experience with direct customer business models and strategic accounts preferred. Skills & Competencies Learning agility and intellectual curiosity, with a proactive approach to building expertise in PTC's business, technology, customers, policies, tools, and evolving commercial models. Comfort and positive energy in a fast-paced, global environment, with the ability to stay effective, organized, and resilient as priorities shift. Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, including the ability to work with incomplete information, evaluate trade-offs, and move topics forward responsibly. Strong commercial mindset and negotiation presence, with the confidence to influence discussions, balance customer and business needs, and seek outcomes that create sustainable value. Relationship-building capability across internal and external audiences, grounded in credibility, trust, active listening, clear communication, and reliable follow-through. Collaborative team-player mindset, demonstrated by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, welcoming feedback, and contributing to a constructive, inclusive team environment. Ability to influence without authority by aligning stakeholders, navigating different perspectives, and creating momentum through clarity and partnership. Analytical and structured thinking, with the ability to connect data, business context, risk, customer signals, and commercial implications into practical recommendations. Strong data-driven decision-making skills, including the ability to leverage analytics, automation, and AI-assisted insights to improve forecasting accuracy, risk identification, and commercial execution. Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and adapt messaging for customers, partners, peers, and senior stakeholders. Fluency in Italian and English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally across customer, partner, and internal stakeholder audiences. High ownership, accountability, and integrity, with a commitment to ethical conduct, transparency, confidentiality, and responsible decision-making. Customer-focused and value-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs while protecting PTC's long-term business interests. Adaptability, inclusiveness, openness to feedback, and continuous-improvement orientation that exemplify PTC values and help strengthen how the team works together. Your Profile This role is a great fit for someone who brings commercial sharpness, customer focus, and positive energy into complex subscription conversations. A successful person is naturally curious, quick to learn, and happy to dive deep into PTC’s products, policies, customer motions, systems, and evolving programs. They do not just “manage renewals” — they connect the dots across customer state, account strategy, contract structure, pricing logic, risk signals, and renewal pathways to help shape the right commercial outcome. They are organized without being rigid, resilient without being stubborn, and confident without losing the ability to listen. Ambiguity does not throw them off; it motivates them to clarify, structure, and move topics forward responsibly. They are comfortable balancing customer needs with PTC’s long-term business interests, spotting churn risk or downgrade signals early, and turning data, business context, and stakeholder input into practical recommendations. Just as importantly, this person builds trust. They communicate clearly in English, simplify complex topics, and create momentum across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, partners, and customers. They know how to influence without formal authority by being credible, prepared, transparent, and reliable in follow-through. Is this you? Hit apply! Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you. If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us? Are you ready to shape global marketing success? We’re now looking for a Marketing Program Planning Lead to drive, refine, and orchestrate large-scale programs that turn Seco’s strategic vision and customer insights into impactful, measurable campaigns. Your new team Join our Marketing Programs team – a small, focused team that turns strategy into action for Seco’s global marketing efforts. We work closely with colleagues across insights, brands, and product areas to ensure our programs are rooted in real customer understanding and deliver meaningful value. We share ideas generously, learn from each other, and build clarity together – always with a shared commitment to making Seco’s communication sharper, smarter, and more relevant to ensure our brand is top of mind. Your mission In this role, you lead the development of large, multi‑year marketing programs that support our strategic direction. You analyze emerging trends, customer behaviors, and internal priorities, then turn these insights into actionable plans. Positioned at the intersection of strategic insights and tactical execution, you develop comprehensive marketing plans and roadmaps that guide integrated campaigns and communications. Your expertise keeps our initiatives insight-driven, strategically focused, and executed through teamwork and continuous learning. Here are some of the areas you work with: Develop multi-year marketing programs based on strategic priorities and insights. Create briefs outlining audience segments, key milestones, and success metrics for large-scale marketing programs. Prepare detailed briefs and kickoff materials that outline objectives, audience, and priorities for the next 12 months. Continuously monitor progress, incorporate new trends and insights, and adapt long-term program plans as needed in close collaboration with the MS&CI team. Embed audience insights and communication needs into long-term program roadmaps. Maintain strong stakeholder connections to gather and share insights across teams. Report on program progress, share learnings, and recommend improvements. Location The position offers flexibility to work remotely or from one of our entities in the UK or Italy. Your profile You have proven experience leading large-scale, multi-year marketing programs aligned with long-term strategic priorities. You’re skilled in translating strategy into structured, measurable initiatives with clear objectives and metrics. Strategic thinking and communication abilities enable effective management of complex, multi-workstream projects while ensuring stakeholders alignment. You have the ability to combine strategic depth with pragmatic execution, consistently delivering results in dynamic environments. You stay curious, ask grounded questions, and adapt quickly when circumstances change. You balance strategic depth with a pragmatic mindset, and you enjoy collaborating closely with others and appreciate a workspace where listening is just as important as guiding. In un contesto caratterizzato da innovazione, sostenibilità e forte orientamento al mercato, l'azienda sta rafforzando la propria organizzazione commerciale e ricerca un Area Sales Manager a supporto dello sviluppo del mercato italiano e zone limitrofe (Svizzera, Austria e Balcani). Il tuo nuovo ruolo A diretto riporto dell'Area Manager Europe, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e del consolidamento del business con focus principale sui distributori italiani. Avrai il compito di gestire l'intero processo commerciale all'interno dei territori assegnati, collaborando attivamente con distributori e clienti per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di crescita definiti dall'azienda. La posizione prevede una forte presenza sul territorio e un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità commerciali, attraverso l'individuazione di nuovi distributori, l'espansione delle quote di mercato e la generazione di nuova domanda. Sarai inoltre coinvolto nella gestione di progetti di sviluppo prodotto, nel supporto alle attività di registrazione e mantenimento delle referenze, nonché nel coordinamento delle iniziative commerciali concordate con i partner locali. Completeranno il ruolo la partecipazione a fiere ed eventi di settore, il monitoraggio delle performance commerciali e delle attività di incasso, oltre alla costante interazione con enti pubblici, stakeholder e principali operatori del mercato agricolo. Di cosa hai bisogno per aver successo Il/La Candidato/a ideale possiede: Laurea in Scienze Agrarie, Agronomia, Ingegneria Agraria o discipline affini. Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli commerciali o export nel settore dei fertilizzanti, agrofarmaci o biostimolanti. Buona conoscenza del mercato agricolo e delle principali dinamiche distributive nei territori assegnati. Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese. Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali e internazionali. Forte orientamento al risultato, spirito imprenditoriale e capacità di sviluppare relazioni commerciali di lungo periodo. Sede di lavoro: Preferibilmente Nord Italia Cosa avrai in cambio Il salary package indicativo sarà tra gli € 50.000 e i € 65.000 fissi + MBO + benefits aziendali tipici per la posizione. L'azienda conta circa 100 dipendenti, sviluppa un fatturato superiore ai 27 milioni di euro e opera sia sul mercato nazionale sia internazionale. Attitudine al confronto con costruttori di macchine e realtà industriali. Soft skills Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali. Approccio consulenziale verso il cliente. Capacità di gestione delle dinamiche tra clienti, agenti e distributori. Pragmatismo, affidabilità e visione di lungo periodo. Autonomia organizzativa. LHH ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da LHH. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 35.000,00 €/yr - 35.000,00 €/anno Per una realtà specializzata in consulenza e marketing digitale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Digital Performance Strategist da inserire all'interno del team dedicato alla gestione di progetti di Performance Marketing. La risorsa sarà il principale punto di riferimento per i clienti assegnati e avrà la responsabilità di coordinare progetti digitali complessi, coniugando attività di consulenza strategica, project management e presidio delle performance. Parliamo quindi di un ruolo di strategia e consulenza pura, non metterà mano alle campagne da un punto di vista operativo. Responsabilità Attività che svolgerà la figura: Gestire la relazione con il portafoglio clienti assegnato, monitorando costantemente KPI, obiettivi e stato di avanzamento dei progetti. Definire e pianificare le milestone progettuali, coordinando le attività dei team interni coinvolti. Tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in piani d'azione concreti e KPI misurabili. Supervisionare le attività operative garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Supportare i clienti nell'individuazione di nuove opportunità di crescita e nell'integrazione di soluzioni innovative nelle strategie di marketing. Monitorare e gestire i principali indicatori di performance, tra cui Budget, ROAS, Revenue, Lead Generation, CPL e CPA. Elaborare forecast, analisi previsionali e pianificazioni di budget a supporto delle decisioni strategiche. Garantire un'efficace comunicazione tra cliente e team interni, assicurando il corretto allineamento delle attività. Profilo Requisiti: Esperienza di almeno 4 anni in ruoli analoghi presso agenzie digitali, società di consulenza o contesti fortemente orientati al performance marketing. Buona conoscenza delle principali piattaforme di advertising digitale, tra cui Google Ads, Meta Ads e altri canali Pay Per Click. Conoscenza di Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e delle principali metodologie di web analytics. Capacità di analizzare dati di business e marketing e di tradurli in insight e raccomandazioni operative. Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft Office, con particolare focus su Excel. Esperienza nella gestione simultanea di progetti complessi e stakeholder multipli. Spiccate capacità relazionali, organizzative e di problem solving. Forte orientamento al risultato e alla soddisfazione del cliente. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (livello minimo B1). Nice to Have Conoscenza di piattaforme DSP e dell'ecosistema Programmatic Advertising. Conoscenza della lingua spagnola. Cosa Offriamo: Contratto a tempo indeterminato Commercio,. Modalità di lavoro full remote. Il team si riunisce un paio di volte l'anno per team building e meeting. RAL indicativa 35.000 euro, commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze del candidato. Buoni pasto da 7 euro per ogni giorno lavorato Welfare e sistema incentivante. Percorsi di formazione continua e aggiornamento professionale. Inserimento in un contesto dinamico, internazionale e orientato all'innovazione. POLIMI GSoM is a leading institution in management education, both in Italy and internationally. We offer a portfolio of more than 40 master's programs, over 300 programs for managers, executives, and professionals, as well as customized learning solutions for organizations. THE ROLE We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Marketing team. The Product Manager is responsible for creating, deploying, tracking and measuring marketing initiatives and strategies for MBA, Masters and executive open programs. He or she will conceive and develop plans for innovative marketing programs that drive customer demand. The Product Manager will be the expert in understanding B2C and B2B customers, their needs, how they select the products they adopt and use, and their buying patterns—and will effectively transfer that knowledge to the sales channel. HOW YOU CAN MAKE A DIFFERENCE In this role, you will: Develop a comprehensive marketing plan for sales and marketing teams including product positioning and communicate the Unique Selling Proposition. Drive product and brand awareness in the higher education market in Italy and internationally. Design and implement new products, plan and manage their launches driving momentum ahead of product launches. Plan and deliver effective communication around the program events organized by the recruiting team to boost the number of both online and face-to-face participants. Plan and deliver mass market multi-channel communication, including DEM and instant messaging, through marketing automation tools and CRM to keep our prospects fully engaged and support lead conversion. Gather market intelligence information, product and customer data from well-known sources and standardize methodology and processes that need to apply to many products. Analyze market data on competitors, segments and verticals and translate information into an action plan to boost product performance. Design and execute go-to-market strategies, focusing on the segmentation of the market to be addressed for either single product or groups of products, as well as product positioning, pricing and promotion through traditional, digital, social channels. Look for new innovative ways to message and deliver existing and new programs. Analyze product P&L to evaluate the feasibility and priority of marketing actions. Own all product collaterals including brochures, web pages, DEMs (Direct Email Marketing) interacting with Salespeople and Marketing vendors to make them happen. Effectively track and measure product performance via regular monitoring and data dashboards throughout the entire enrollment funnel: from lead generation to final enrollment. Design and implement surveys to discover customers’ preferences, satisfaction and decision-making criteria. Manage internal and external marketing vendors and suppliers. WHAT COULD MAKE YOU THE RIGHT PERSON Minimum 3 years of Marketing experience, preferably in the Education sector; Fluency in English and Italian; Ability to interpret numbers and data; Strong communication and presentation skills; Familiarity with CRM (preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365) and business Intelligence software and databases; Strong knowledge of Excel, Word and PowerPoint; Experience or strong willing to bring content-based learning solutions to market Customer-focused; ability to create successful products by determining customer needs and challenges and translating those into a strong and proven product and value story for the market. Possess solid understanding of financial and business metrics, including P&L statements, conversion rates, market share, gross margin, customer satisfaction, and repurchasing rates. Ability to champion and execute market-oriented new and innovative approaches, ideas, methods, processes, products and services WHY JOIN US What We Offer Permanent employment contract (CCNL Commercio); Salary range approximately between €30,000 and €40,000 gross annual salary; Performance incentives, corporate welfare benefits, and meal vouchers; Hybrid working model; Flexible working hours; 8 hours of paid volunteering leave per year; Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) supporting diversity and inclusion; Top Employer certified company; Workplace location: Milan. WHAT MAKES THIS OPPORTUNITY MORE THAN A JOB Your Impact You will support the promotion of MBA, Master's and Executive Education programs, helping professionals and organizations develop the skills they need to shape their future. By transforming data, insights and customer needs into engaging and effective experiences, you will help attract and guide talented individuals from around the world throughout their personal and professional development journey. Every project you lead will have a tangible impact on the growth of individuals, organizations and the global management community. Our Commitment to Inclusion We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace where every individual feels valued regardless of gender, age, background, orientation, or ability. We believe diversity is a fundamental strength and a driver of growth.
